| | |
### Senate Update: No Kings: Fighting Trump's Illegal War, His Lawless ICE Operations and His Schemes to Rig the Midterm Elections
Over the past two months, I have been doing everything I can to fight back against a torrent of attacks on our democracy and constitution from Donald Trump and his corrupt administration. Overseas, Trump launched an illegal war of choice against Iran that is making us less safe, while here at home, he continues to violate peoples' due process rights to implement his mass deportation agenda. For weeks, he and Republicans in Congress withheld funds from TSA, the Coast Guard, and FEMA to try to get Democrats to back off our demands to rein in his lawless ICE operations. At the same time, he is hellbent on trying to rig the midterm elections through a voter suppression scheme and issuing illegal executive orders to try to federalize control over elections.

Our fellow Marylanders and Americans are not letting Trump's lawless actions go unanswered. Last weekend, I joined thousands of patriots across the state - from [Laurel](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.instagram.com%2fp%2fDWb9m_WEfxc%2f&redir_log=890199155113270), [Catonsville](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.instagram.com%2fp%2fDWcRjCVjwhS%2f&redir_log=763684104973271), Baltimore, and [Aberdeen](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.instagram.com%2freels%2fDWhUIvEDtQl%2f&redir_log=463687278785299) - for No Kings Day, to resist Trump's efforts to dismantle our democracy. At each stop, the message rang loud and clear: Americans wouldn't put up with a king back in 1776, and we will NOT put up with a wannabe king now. Trump, like other bullies, wants us all to cower in the corner, shut up, and go away. Instead, Marylanders joined with millions of our fellow Americans to stand up, speak out and fight back.

In the Senate, I will continue to push back with the same passion as our fellow Americans in Minneapolis and around the country.
---
### Opposing Trump's Illegal War of Choice with Iran
During their campaign, Donald Trump and JD Vance repeatedly promised that they would not drag America into another war, especially one in the Middle East. They broke that promise when the United States and Israel launched an illegal war of choice against Iran - a war that is making America [less, not more safe](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.instagram.com%2freels%2fDWhaqptlb9L%2f&redir_log=776320075789302). The Trump Administration has only offered constantly [shifting rationales](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.instagram.com%2freels%2fDWPmq75D9k2%2f&redir_log=419524134515290) and they have no endgame in sight. Just last night in Donald Trump's address to the American people, he still could not justify this war nor provide a clear vision for moving forward - it was more of the same contradictions, lies and vague promises we've been hearing for weeks.

He's trying to gaslight the American people. Over two weeks ago, he said "we won" - so why are we still there? It's clear he has no plan to end this war of choice, so he's resorting to the only thing he knows how to do: spread more lies. His delusions are endangering our country and the world.

They haven't even been able to keep their stories straight behind closed doors. We have received a handful of [classified briefings](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.instagram.com%2fp%2fDVcbYnFjGtm%2f&redir_log=713219331809272) in the Senate because they refuse to hold public hearings with policymakers. That is a clear sign of the weakness of their case: they realize it cannot withstand public scrutiny.

That's why right from the start, I have been sounding the alarm and speaking out on the [Senate floor](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.youtube.com%2flive%2fY_eKH6fSV3g%3fsi%3dLvgUu0mcttLSnWCn&redir_log=005501184584409) against the war and standing up for what the Constitution makes clear: only Congress can decide whether the United States goes to war. Yet, President Trump launched this regime-change war against Iran that is [not in America's best interest](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fbsky.app%2fprofile%2fvanhollen.senate.gov%2fpost%2f3mhjgpt24g22t&redir_log=147134489542440), without Congressional authorization.

As of today, 13 brave American servicemembers have lost their lives in this war. Hundreds more have been wounded. Their sacrifice deserves more respect than the President casually remarking that "sadly, there likely will be more...that's the way it is."

Meanwhile, the conflict is escalating across the region - with more than 2,000 civilians killed, tens of thousands injured, and millions displaced so far.

The war has disrupted the flow of oil through the Strait of Hormuz, significantly[ raising gas and diesel prices ](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.instagram.com%2fp%2fDWKX7OpD6Au%2f%3futm_source%3dig_web_copy_link%26igsh%3dMzRlODBiNWFlZA%3d%3d&redir_log=987871559151638)for Americans here at home. The administration clearly didn't have a plan for these predictable consequences of their illegal war and have now resorted to [easing sanctions](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fimo%2fmedia%2fdoc%2fletter_to_potus_on_russia_and_iran_sanctions_relief.pdf&redir_log=445635340321733) on Russian and Iranian oil, fueling both [Putin's war machine](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fsenate-democratic-leaders-release-joint-statement-on-trump-administrations-weakening-of-sanctions-on-russian-oil-in-attempt-to-dampen-economic-impacts-of-trumps-iran-war&redir_log=952814386911562) and the Iranian regime as well. Trump continues to brush off concerns over the high energy prices, telling our European allies to deal with the problem posed by Iran's blockade of the Strait of Hormuz - a problem that was the direct consequence of his reckless actions.

Public reports suggest that the Defense Department is expending munitions and missile defense interceptors at an alarming rate. An initial estimate from the Defense Department said that the United States has spent over $12 billion in just the [first week](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fbsky.app%2fprofile%2fvanhollen.senate.gov%2fpost%2f3mhc3o4iers2k&redir_log=816966777258443) of this war, and it continues to cost American taxpayers over $2 billion every day. In other words, this war has been a costly strategic blunder from top to bottom.

This war has also resulted in devastating civilian harm from U.S. airstrikes. I have [demanded transparency](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.instagram.com%2freels%2fDWROGX-AJ_0%2f&redir_log=590855206644287) - including leading an effort with nearly the [entire Democratic caucus](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-kaine-schatz-warren-lead-over-40-senators-in-pressing-dod-for-answers-on-school-bombing-and-civilian-casualties-in-iran&redir_log=244294796231276) pressing the Department of Defense for answers about a strike on a girls' elementary school in Minab, Iran that killed at least 168 civilians, most of them children. Even during armed conflict, the United States must abide by U.S. and international law, including the laws of war. Reports also indicate that strikes have damaged hospitals, cultural sites, and other critical civilian infrastructure.

These actions undermine America's credibility and national security interests around the world. That is why we are demanding a full investigation into these incidents and transparency about what happened, as well as accountability for any violations of U.S. or international law.
### Reining in ICE while Reopening TSA & Other Critical Agencies
For weeks, we urged Republicans to stop holding TSA, FEMA, the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) and the Coast Guard hostage, and restore pay for these civil servants - while we continue negotiating meaningful reforms to ICE and Border Patrol.

After Republicans [rejected 14 attempts](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fbsky.app%2fprofile%2fvanhollen.senate.gov%2fpost%2f3mhobicnxbk24&redir_log=197826080957446) by Senate Democrats on the Senate Floor to do just that, they finally relented - but only after their inaction led to worsening chaos at airports across the country and considerable hardship for unpaid federal workers. We also demanded that this funding agreement include no funding for Trump's lawless ICE and Border Patrol - operations that have instilled fear in communities across the country, violated individuals' constitutional rights on a vast scale, and killed U.S. citizens, including Renee Good and Alex Pretti.

Trump and Republicans thought they could hold funding for the entire Department of Homeland Security hostage to pressure us into backing down on our demands to rein in Trump's ICE army. They wanted a blank check. [We did not back down](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fbsky.app%2fprofile%2fvanhollen.senate.gov%2fpost%2f3micw5d63xk26&redir_log=786561147827436). The Senate ultimately passed our proposal by a unanimous bipartisan vote and, earlier today, reaffirmed that plan and sent the House a clean bill. The Republican-controlled House failed to pass it today, but Trump has called upon them to fall in line. There is no good reason for House Republicans to delay any longer. We should fully fund TSA, FEMA, CISA, and the Coast Guard now.

As I have said [repeatedly](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.youtube.com%2flive%2fJsz_fl_sRtM%3fsi%3doEFgTfQUke6S2xKg&redir_log=368415976678409), I will not support one more dime for Trump's out-of-control immigration agencies without changes that the majority of Americans support, like an [independent investigation](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.instagram.com%2freels%2fDWSNA71FvuZ%2f&redir_log=464648635144293) into the killing of Renee Good and Alex Pretti to ensure accountability. We can't trust Trump's DHS to conduct a credible independent investigation when they call the victims of their deadly violence "domestic terrorists," and won't even apologize to their families for their killings. Meanwhile, they're denying local law enforcement authorities in Minneapolis access to evidence. It is unacceptable to shield wrongful actions from accountability.

The fight against a lawless ICE also continues here in Maryland, where we continue to respond to reports about the Trump Administration's mass deportation operations and [ICE detention facilities](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.instagram.com%2fp%2fDVrp7Y4EqHU%2f&redir_log=393104654634265). ICE spent more than $100 million in taxpayer funds to buy a warehouse in Washington County - and they intend to use that facility to detain up to 1,500 people. Thankfully, a federal judge has temporarily halted construction at the facility due to a lawsuit filed by the Maryland Attorney General's office.

Donald Trump pledged to go after the "worst of the worst" but has focused primarily on thousands of people that DHS's own data reveal pose no risk to public safety. The overwhelming majority of Marylanders do not want ICE terrorizing our communities nor their mass detention facilities in our state, and I will continue fighting against Trump's mass deportation agenda.
### Protecting Our Elections Against the Misnamed "SAVE America Act"
Instead of working to lower prices or help American families facing the consequences of an illegal war, Trump and Republicans spent much of the last few weeks trying to jam through the Senate the deceptively named "SAVE America Act," which is, in fact, a Trojan Horse to make it harder for millions of American citizens to exercise their right to vote. I spoke out on the [Senate floor](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.youtube.com%2flive%2fCPcx_43m2Sc%3fsi%3dbf96hhKB-55bJEOe&redir_log=792893725857389) against this completely [fraudulent bill](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fbsky.app%2fprofile%2fvanhollen.senate.gov%2fpost%2f3mhdyemmekk2r&redir_log=049332112781451) because we cannot stand by as Trump and his Republican lackeys spread lies about the purpose and impact of their scheme.

And just this week, Trump signed a purely political executive order as another step in his unconstitutional effort to try to federalize and seize control over voting. He's taking this outrageous step because we are standing up in the Senate to block his voter suppression bill. We must keep fighting back because the truth is that none of this is about election security. It's about enabling Trump to rig the midterm elections so he can evade accountability for his broken promises and failed policies.

This bill would require certain kinds of ID to demonstrate you're an American citizen to register to vote - such as a passport or an original birth certificate. But for those without either document, if they want to vote, they will have to spend lots of time and money to get one. That's a poll tax. In America, we don't have to pay in order to exercise our right to vote.

[This is a scam](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fbsky.app%2fprofile%2fvanhollen.senate.gov%2fpost%2f3mhol7q43lc2q&redir_log=534334643006440). Indeed, Donald Trump himself said that Republicans need to pass this bill to "guarantee" them a win in the next midterm election. In other words, they want to purge American citizens - targeting those they think are likely to vote against Republicans - from the voter registration files.

We cannot stand by and let this happen. Kings don't like elections, but I will continue to sound the alarm and put a stop to their un-American efforts to rig them in their favor.
### Demanding Transparency on the Epstein Files
It's completely unacceptable that the Trump Administration continues to [hide documents](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fbsky.app%2fprofile%2fvanhollen.senate.gov%2fpost%2f3mgb7c4mwd226&redir_log=252225725889435) related to Jeffrey Epstein. Time and again, Trump tries to distract from the truth here. The American people - and especially the survivors of Epstein's crimes - deserve transparency and accountability.

During an Appropriations Committee hearing last year, Secretary Lutnick made a big show of telling us that he cut off all contact with Jeffrey Epstein in 2005. But documents from the Epstein files revealed that he visited Epstein's private island years after Epstein's conviction for soliciting prostitution from a minor. When I confronted him with his lie at a more recent hearing, [Lutnick admitted](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fbsky.app%2fprofile%2fvanhollen.senate.gov%2fpost%2f3mekafkvlps2g&redir_log=902982912494450) that in 2012 - after Epstein was convicted - he did take his family, as well as their nanny, to visit Epstein on his island.

Following the hearing, Senator Jeff Merkley and I pushed Secretary Lutnick to provide a full accounting of his interactions with Epstein, including records of meetings, communications, and business dealings. Since then, he has agreed to appear before the House Oversight Committee. I will closely monitor that hearing.

Unfortunately, the Trump Administration is continuing to stonewall the public, releasing documents that [expose survivors' identities](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fbsky.app%2fprofile%2fvanhollen.senate.gov%2fpost%2f3mef5tqj44k2b&redir_log=518486527419439) while shielding powerful individuals connected to Epstein. It's clear Trump and his cronies want to keep the American people, and the victims, in the dark.

That is unacceptable. I will continue pushing for full transparency, so the full truth comes out. No one is above the law.
### Delivering for Communities Across Maryland
While I fight Donald Trump's assault on democracy and our freedoms, I am inspired by my fellow Marylanders and Americans who also refuse to back down in the face of these threats. Instead, they have partnered with us to protect our shared values and help our communities in the face of such challenging times.

Recently, I had the opportunity to meet with members of the Montgomery County Jewish community at a forum hosted by the Tikvat Israel congregation in Rockville. We had a meaningful conversation about the need to combat the rising threat of antisemitism and my work in the Senate to invest in the security grants to protect synagogues and other houses of worship. We must fight back against antisemitism and call it out in our [community](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fimo%2fmedia%2fimage%2f2.10.26.jpg&redir_log=878788460605393) and [country](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fimo%2fmedia%2fimage%2f3.12.26.jpg&redir_log=076769169657394). We must make clear that hate, racism and bigotry in all their poisonous forms have no place here. That's why we must also call out virulent [anti-Muslim](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fimo%2fmedia%2fimage%2f3.13.26.jpg&redir_log=144009213885394) statements made by [members of Congress](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fimo%2fmedia%2fimage%2f1.19.26.jpg&redir_log=420460928685394). We must also push back against the Trump Administration's efforts to erase our history. At a time when so many seek to divide us, we must be able to express strong differences of opinion on important issues in a respectful and civil manner.

In Anne Arundel County, I joined local leaders to celebrate several projects made possible with the help of federal investments we secured, including funding for the YWCA of Annapolis and Anne Arundel County to expand housing and job training programs for survivors of domestic violence, investments to rehabilitate the Meyer Building at Crownsville Hospital Memorial Park, resources to support community-based gun violence prevention programs, upgrades to the county's Joint 911 Public Safety Center, and support for the Anne Arundel County Food Bank to expand food distribution to families in need.

I also visited communities on Maryland's [Eastern Shore](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-alsobrooks-visit-kent-queen-annes-to-highlight-federal-investments-secured-for-local-communities&redir_log=043026543961133), including Kent County, to announce federal funds we secured to support the installation of a backup generator at the county's EMS headquarters to ensure emergency services remain operational during power disruptions. And, in Queen Anne's County, we announced federal funds we obtained to help the Town of Barclay construct a new community center and town hall, expanding its capacity to serve local residents.

In Prince George's County, we marked the delivery of federal funding to support youth and community programs in Greenbelt and Bladensburg, including improvements to the Springhill Lake Recreation Center and repairs to the Greenbelt Youth Center roof so it can continue serving local families.

In Western Maryland, I joined local leaders in Frederick for the kickoff of the PACT Task Force, a regional effort bringing together government officials, health providers, nonprofits, and community leaders to protect access to care as we confront cuts to the Affordable Care Act, to Medicaid and to food programs resulting from what Trump and Republicans called their "Big, Beautiful Bill." We also celebrated federal funding secured to build out the Biomedical Research and Training Center at [Hood College](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-mcclain-delaney-visit-hood-college-highlight-25-million-in-federal-funding-secured-to-bolster-biotech-research-and-job-training-program&redir_log=596095205191390) - as part of the Maryland Tech Council's BioHub initiative to train students and workers in biotechnology. And in Annapolis, we announced the long-awaited release of more than $35 million in federal funding from the Federal Emergency Management Agency to support the [Annapolis City Dock resiliency project](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-alsobrooks-elfreth-littmann-announce-fema-release-of-over-35-million-for-annapolis-city-dock-flood-resilience-construction&redir_log=958141532031307). This investment will fund critical flood protection and stormwater improvements to safeguard roughly 1,200 feet of the historic waterfront from increasingly frequent tidal flooding.

Finally, I'd like to acknowledge the solemn [two-year anniversary](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.instagram.com%2fp%2fDWWwtyREcBp%2f%3futm_source%3dig_web_copy_link%26igsh%3dMzRlODBiNWFlZA%253D%253D&redir_log=309287930507657) last week of the Francis Scott Key Bridge collapse, on March 26, 2024. We all remember where we were when we learned the Key Bridge fell, and on this day, our hearts are especially with the families of the six Baltimore workers who lost their lives.

Out of this tragedy, Team Maryland came together. And alongside our local leaders and state partners, we worked to quickly secure federal support for this project, and to tackle the immediate clean-up necessary to reopen the channel to the Port of Baltimore. Federal Team Maryland also fought tooth and nail to secure a 100% federal cost-match for the bridge replacement with the Baltimore BRIDGE Relief Act, and we're continuing to fight to ensure that promise is upheld.
### Thank You
As we continue to face historic challenges to our democracy and our country, I salute you for staying engaged. With your help, I will continue fighting for Marylanders - and for a brighter future for all Americans - in every way I can.

Onwards, Chris Van Hollen
To see more on my daily efforts to fight back against the Trump Administration, follow me on: [YouTube](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.youtube.com%2f%40senatorvanhollen&redir_log=49030338036296), [Bluesky](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fbsky.app%2fprofile%2fvanhollen.senate.gov&redir_log=939838092693319), [Instagram](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.instagram.com%2fchrisvanhollen%2f&redir_log=389295287187292), [Threads](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.threads.com%2f%40chrisvanhollen&redir_log=958032566321279), [Facebook](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.facebook.com%2fchrisvanhollen%2f&redir_log=328155479639284), and [X](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15616.60317662.7871858.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fx.com%2fChrisVanHollen&redir_log=218313979356198).

In a deeply personal revelation, Grammy Award-winning artist Gwen Stefani has opened up about a spiritual awakening that transformed her life, occurring around the birth of her youngest son, Apollo, at age 44--a moment she describes as a "miracle."

The No Doubt frontwoman, who grew up in a Catholic household in Anaheim, California, recently shared her faith journey during an interview with the Hallow app, a Catholic prayer and meditation platform. During the conversation, Stefani reflected on how her religious roots, which had faded during her adult years, were reignited through extraordinary circumstances surrounding her third pregnancy.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.qu3c8Zb5ggWC39zQGvUo4pfffRgvPhsB12afDlEqbYo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=192981087)
Stefani revealed that her renewed focus on spirituality began during a period when she was struggling to conceive. Her son Kingston, one of her children from her previous marriage to Gavin Rossdale, began praying earnestly for a sibling. According to the singer, just weeks after Kingston's prayers began, she discovered she was pregnant at age 44--a medical circumstance that often presents significant challenges for women seeking to conceive.

"It was a full-on gift," Stefani described of the pregnancy, which she attributes to divine intervention. The birth of Apollo in 2014 became a pivotal turning point in her spiritual life, drawing her back to the faith of her childhood and establishing what she now considers her most important relationship.

"The only thing that's important in life is your relationship with God," Stefani has stated, marking a profound shift from her public persona as a rock and pop icon. Her transformation has not been limited to personal belief--she has actively worked to share her faith journey with others and has reportedly helped her husband, country music star Blake Shelton, grow closer to the Catholic faith as they aim to raise their blended family with religious values.

Stefani's alignment with faith-based platforms has not been without controversy. Her partnership with Hallow, which has also been promoted by prominent conservative figures including Senator JD Vance and tech billionaire Peter Thiel, has drawn criticism from some quarters. The app, which offers daily prayers, meditation, and religious education, has become increasingly visible in mainstream culture, including through Super Bowl advertising campaigns.

Despite criticism, Stefani has remained vocal about her beliefs, using her platform to discuss how prayer and spiritual practice have grounded her amid the chaos of fame. The singer, whose career spans over three decades with hits like "Don't Speak," "Hollaback Girl," and "The Sweet Escape," represents a notable example of celebrities publicly embracing faith later in life.

For Stefani, the birth of Apollo at 44, with her and _ex-husband Gavin Rossdale_ 's third son, stands as a testament to what she believes is possible through prayer and divine grace. Her story resonates with many people of faith who view unexpected blessings as evidence of spiritual presence in daily life. As she continues her career while raising her family, Stefani's journey from Catholic schoolgirl to rock star to renewed believer illustrates how personal crises and milestones can reshape one's understanding of life's deeper meaning.

Her testimony serves as a reminder that spiritual awakenings can come at any age, often through the most unexpected of circumstances.

Gwen Stefani's experience becoming a mother at 44 sparked a deeply personal return to the faith she grew up with. | | | Apr 2 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- In a deeply personal revelation, Grammy Award-winning artist Gwen Stefani has opened up about a spiritual awakening that transformed her life, occurring around the birth of her youngest son, Apollo, at age 44--a moment she describes as a "miracle." The No Doubt frontwoman, who grew up in a Catholic household in Anaheim, California, recently shared her faith journey during an interview with the Hallow app, a Catholic prayer and meditation platform. During the conversation, Stefani reflected on how her religious roots, which had faded during her adult years, were reignited through extraordinary circumstances surrounding her third pregnancy. Stefani revealed that her renewed focus on spirituality began during a period when she was struggling to conceive. Her son Kingston, one of her children from her previous marriage to Gavin Rossdale, began praying earnestly for a sibling. According to the singer, just weeks after Kingston's prayers began, she discovered she was pregnant at age 44--a medical circumstance that often presents significant challenges for women seeking to conceive. "It was a full-on gift," Stefani described of the pregnancy, which she attributes to divine intervention. The birth of Apollo in 2014 became a pivotal turning point in her spiritual life, drawing her back to the faith of her childhood and establishing what she now considers her most important relationship. "The only thing that's important in life is your relationship with God," Stefani has stated, marking a profound shift from her public persona as a rock and pop icon. Her transformation has not been limited to personal belief--she has actively worked to share her faith journey with others and has reportedly helped her husband, country music star Blake Shelton, grow closer to the Catholic faith as they aim to raise their blended family with religious values. Stefani's alignment with faith-based platforms has not been without controversy. Her partnership with Hallow, which has also been promoted by prominent conservative figures including Senator JD Vance and tech billionaire Peter Thiel, has drawn criticism from some quarters. The app, which offers daily prayers, meditation, and religious education, has become increasingly visible in mainstream culture, including through Super Bowl advertising campaigns. Despite criticism, Stefani has remained vocal about her beliefs, using her platform to discuss how prayer and spiritual practice have grounded her amid the chaos of fame. The singer, whose career spans over three decades with hits like "Don't Speak," "Hollaback Girl," and "The Sweet Escape," represents a notable example of celebrities publicly embracing faith later in life. For Stefani, the birth of Apollo at 44, with her and ex-husband Gavin Rossdale 's third son, stands as a testament to what she believes is possible through prayer and divine grace. Her story resonates with many people of faith who view unexpected blessings as evidence of spiritual presence in daily life. As she continues her career while raising her family, Stefani's journey from Catholic schoolgirl to rock star to renewed believer illustrates how personal crises and milestones can reshape one's understanding of life's deeper meaning. Her testimony serves as a reminder that spiritual awakenings can come at any age, often through the most unexpected of circumstances. This Substack is reader-supported. ** Celebrating Autism Awareness Day!
------------------------------------------------------------
http://www.autismhealth.com?mc_cid=e3b341f511&mc_eid=UNIQID

Today, on World Autism Awareness Day, we come together to recognize and support individuals and families impacted by autism. It is a day to raise awareness, encourage understanding, and reflect on how we can better serve this growing community.

At Autism Health Inc., our mission goes beyond awareness. We are committed to providing education, resources, and community support for families navigating autism and related neurological conditions. Through initiatives such as the Autism Health Summit, monthly webinars, support groups, educational scholarships, and partnerships with leading researchers and practitioners, we work to bring meaningful solutions and information directly to those who need it most.

None of this would be possible without the generosity of our community. Your donations are what keep our mission moving forward, allowing us to expand our programs, support more families, and continue advancing education and research in autism care. Every contribution makes a meaningful difference.

Today, we honor the strength, resilience, and dedication of families, caregivers, and individuals on the autism journey. Together, we continue to move forward with purpose, compassion, and a shared commitment to making a lasting impact.
DONATE HERE (https://autismhealth.com/donations/?mc_cid=e3b341f511&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** The 2026 Autism Health Summit is Almost Here!
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JyPTtXfKYd8&mc_cid=e3b341f511&mc_eid=UNIQID

April 24–26, 2026 | Legacy Center Resort & Spa | San Diego, California

As our flagship educational event, the Summit brings together leading voices in research, medicine, advocacy, and integrative health. This annual gathering is designed for parents, practitioners, researchers, and advocates seeking deeper insight into autism and neurological health from a whole-body, whole-family perspective.

The Autism Health Summit also offers Continuing Medical Education (CME) credits for medical professionals, providing an opportunity to gain valuable, evidence-informed insights while fulfilling continuing education requirements.

We are honored to host an extraordinary lineup of speakers, including Aaron Siri, Del Bigtree, Dr. Toby Rogers, Dr. Sabine Hazan, Dr. Dayan Goodenowe, Ed Clay, and many more respected experts and thought leaders. Hi there, it's Nellie Pou.

I'm reaching out today to say thank you! Because of your help, our campaign reached our goal and finished the first quarter of the election year on a strong note.

As we look ahead to the rest of the year, we must continue to build on this momentum together.

MAGA Republicans have their sights set on this seat in Congress. They've already recruited someone to run against me. Now, it's up to us to ensure we have the resources to build a winning campaign, hold this seat, and help take back the House in November.

Thank you again for your continued support,

Nellie
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP61/1/115406/images/pou_headshot_crop.jpg]

name: Forward Party
subject: What’s the Deal with… Mail-In Voting?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Forward Party and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Americans want elections that are secure and easy to participate in. Mail-in voting is one of the ways we make that possible.

| | | [ ](www.forwardparty.com)
---
### Peter —
Americans want elections that are secure and easy to participate in. Mail-in voting is one of the ways we make that possible. It’s back in the spotlight right now because of a new executive order from President Trump that would limit how states use mail-in voting and add new federal requirements around who can receive a ballot. That kind of top-down change raises real questions, both legal and practical, for states that are responsible for running elections and for voters who rely on these systems. Before getting lost in the politics of the moment, it’s worth stepping back and looking at how mail-in works, and why so many Americans use it. Mail-in voting is not new. Americans have been voting by mail for generations, starting with military members serving overseas and expanding over time to include seniors, rural voters, and anyone who needs more flexibility. Today, it is a part of how elections are run across the country. In states like Colorado, Oregon, Washington, Utah, and Hawaii, elections are conducted almost entirely by mail. Across the country, millions of voters use it every cycle, regardless of party. **In fact, about one in three Americans has voted by mail in recent national elections -[ including the President himself.](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=wWw1LGKe09YoyrHaTkDQ4GG1qh98GYcXj0zaOWKzAEQwmXOJVWdP973GAiE68ci8-mgBWdeD_mPPmjT07g1CVY0BxumMe2LG6pQr9kCl2GAhF_Iv68-i7juMW_u7z5BB&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_96a&n=1) **That alone tells you something important: this is not a niche system. It is a normal, widely used way Americans participate in democracy. Security is often where the conversation turns around mail-in ballots. A system only works if people trust it. Mail-in voting includes multiple layers of protection. Ballots are tied to registered voters, signatures are verified, and many states use tracking systems so voters can see when their ballot is sent, received, and counted. Like any system, it is not perfect, but there is no evidence of widespread fraud. What there is, instead, is a system that has been tested at scale and continues to work. For many people, mail-in voting is not about convenience. It is about access. It allows a parent working two jobs, a senior who cannot stand in line, or a voter living miles from the nearest polling place to still have a voice. For military families and Americans overseas, it is often the only realistic option. That is why sudden, nationwide changes to the system could cause confusion, disenfranchisement, and barriers to voting. The current proposal would require states to adjust how they administer mail-in voting and who qualifies for it. Even setting aside the legal questions about whether a president can direct those changes, the practical impact could be significant. States would need to rework systems quickly. Voters could face confusion about eligibility. Ballots could be delayed or rejected under new rules. That is not how you build confidence in elections. It is how you create uncertainty. At Forward, we believe this should not be an either-or debate. Americans want elections that are both secure and accessible. Those goals are not in conflict. In fact, the best systems do both well. The answer is not to restrict access or to ignore concerns about integrity. It is to improve the system in ways that are transparent, consistent, and based on what actually works. The bigger issue here is not just mail-in voting. It is whether our political system is focused on serving voters or fighting over the rules of the game. Too often, the conversation is about control instead of outcomes, about process instead of people. Americans are looking for something different. They want a system that works. They want to know their vote counts and that they have a real voice in the outcome. That means making it easier for eligible voters to participate while strengthening trust in how elections are run. It means working with states, not around them. And it means focusing on solutions that bring people in, not push them out. That is how we move forward. **Please forward this to your friends, family, and coworkers. It helps us introduce them to Forward and to what we are building. Also consider inviting them to one of our upcoming events listed below. We'd love to meet them.**

### [Kevin Kiley Leaves GOP, Bets on Independent Voters in California's 6th District](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=rDd8ldfLFk-s1hATdsbsrXHOdDMtBDv_87cp6Bn7xeJ_8J5mjDc1Mqex-d1l-Hbvk5WR4m723OvdMZ6UHJJuzkbbXHtHqjkhV8lIhy8txLHX2vrPsEDJbCBB8F3qclveLKdh8RZS172pE_k_wkmHJA&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_96a&n=15)

Mail-in voting is one of the ways we make that possible. | | | www.forwardparty.com Peter — Americans want elections that are secure and easy to participate in. Mail-in voting is one of the ways we make that possible. It’s back in the spotlight right now because of a new executive order from President Trump that would limit how states use mail-in voting and add new federal requirements around who can receive a ballot. That kind of top-down change raises real questions, both legal and practical, for states that are responsible for running elections and for voters who rely on these systems. Before getting lost in the politics of the moment, it’s worth stepping back and looking at how mail-in works, and why so many Americans use it. Mail-in voting is not new. Americans have been voting by mail for generations, starting with military members serving overseas and expanding over time to include seniors, rural voters, and anyone who needs more flexibility. Today, it is a part of how elections are run across the country. In states like Colorado, Oregon, Washington, Utah, and Hawaii, elections are conducted almost entirely by mail. Across the country, millions of voters use it every cycle, regardless of party. In fact, about one in three Americans has voted by mail in recent national elections - That alone tells you something important: this is not a niche system. It is a normal, widely used way Americans participate in democracy. Security is often where the conversation turns around mail-in ballots. A system only works if people trust it. Mail-in voting includes multiple layers of protection. Ballots are tied to registered voters, signatures are verified, and many states use tracking systems so voters can see when their ballot is sent, received, and counted. Like any system, it is not perfect, but there is no evidence of widespread fraud. What there is, instead, is a system that has been tested at scale and continues to work. For many people, mail-in voting is not about convenience. It is about access. It allows a parent working two jobs, a senior who cannot stand in line, or a voter living miles from the nearest polling place to still have a voice. For military families and Americans overseas, it is often the only realistic option. That is why sudden, nationwide changes to the system could cause confusion, disenfranchisement, and barriers to voting. The current proposal would require states to adjust how they administer mail-in voting and who qualifies for it. Even setting aside the legal questions about whether a president can direct those changes, the practical impact could be significant. States would need to rework systems quickly. Voters could face confusion about eligibility. Ballots could be delayed or rejected under new rules. That is not how you build confidence in elections. It is how you create uncertainty. At Forward, we believe this should not be an either-or debate. Americans want elections that are both secure and accessible. Those goals are not in conflict. In fact, the best systems do both well. The answer is not to restrict access or to ignore concerns about integrity. It is to improve the system in ways that are transparent, consistent, and based on what actually works. The bigger issue here is not just mail-in voting. It is whether our political system is focused on serving voters or fighting over the rules of the game. Too often, the conversation is about control instead of outcomes, about process instead of people. Americans are looking for something different. They want a system that works. They want to know their vote counts and that they have a real voice in the outcome. That means making it easier for eligible voters to participate while strengthening trust in how elections are run. It means working with states, not around them. And it means focusing on solutions that bring people in, not push them out. That is how we move forward. ### **Help us defeat the mainstream media and promote capitalism and American exceptionalism.**
### **[Support The Capitalist, become a paid subscriber today:](https://substack.com/redirect/1849be6b-4021-4a1e-ac29-b6a487318e34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

* * *
* * *
**President Trump campaigned** on the idea of "Making America Great Again," when he left the podium on April the First after delivering **[his address to the nation](https://substack.com/redirect/96296b86-5458-4921-a3a8-17e522856653?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , it was crystal clear that in three distinct areas he has achieved this. The chattering pundit class on cable news can clasp their pearls and screech all they want, but the reality speaks volumes.
* * *
_" This situation has been going on for 47 years, and should have been handled long before I arrived in office."_ **\- President Trump - April 1st 2026**
* * *
President Trump's blunt assessment cuts through decades of Washington delusion. For nearly half a century, American presidents from both parties kicked the Iranian can down the road, hoping sanctions, speeches, half-hearted deals or even cold hard cash would somehow contain a regime that has never hidden its intentions. Trump chose a different path. In June he ordered strikes on Iran's key nuclear facilities in Operation Midnight Hammer, declaring: "I vowed that I would never allow Iran to have a nuclear weapon."
He is right to remind us of the bloody record: the 1983 Beirut barracks bombing that killed 241 Americans, the roadside bombs and car bombs that slaughtered hundreds of U.S. troops in Iraq, the atrocities of October 7, and the regime's recent slaughter of 45,000 of its own people protesting in the streets. For 47 years the chant has remained the same: **" Death to America, death to Israel."**
Successive administrations treated Iran as a manageable nuisance rather than the root cause of regional instability and terror. They allowed Iranian proxies to kill Americans while pursuing ever-more elaborate diplomatic dances. Trump made the call and acted. In just 32 days he has done more to shift the balance of power in the Middle East than decades of previous involvement, because he went straight to the source.
The fanatical regime that sponsors proxies, builds nuclear infrastructure and ballistic **[missile programs with global reach](https://substack.com/redirect/54c9d749-f4b6-4462-8b8e-5522ab9894de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in secret, and murders its own citizens was on the verge of acquiring the ultimate shield. Trump refused to let the most violent and aggressively thuggish regime on earth operate behind a nuclear umbrella. His first preference was always diplomacy, but when the regime rejected every reasonable offer and continued its relentless quest for nuclear weapons, he acted decisively.
This is what real leadership looks like: recognizing a threat that previous presidents preferred to **manage rather than eliminate.** Trump did not start this conflict -- Iran's 47-year campaign of terror and nuclear defiance did. He simply chose to end the era of American hesitation. The old policy of kicking the can down the road is over.
* * *

# [Tackle your credit card debt with 0% interest until nearly 2026](https://substack.com/redirect/8a463605-ff28-4d45-bdc8-3a91da977c09?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Did you know some credit cards can actually help you get out of debt faster?
Yes, it sounds crazy. **But it 's true.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8a463605-ff28-4d45-bdc8-3a91da977c09?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**The secret:**
* Find a card with a "0% intro APR" period for balance transfers.

### **Trump 's Energy Independence Has Finally Set America Free**
* * *
_" Many Americans have been concerned to see the recent rise in gasoline prices here at home. This short-term increase has been entirely the result of the Iranian regime launching deranged terror attacks against commercial oil tankers and neighboring countries that have nothing to do with the conflict."_ **\- President Trump - April 1st 2026**
* * *
Again, Trump is right. The current spike in U.S. gas prices is real, but it is temporary and entirely inflicted by Iran's aggression against its neighbors. Meanwhile, much of the rest of the world is facing actual fuel shortages because entire nations still depend on Middle Eastern oil flowing through the Strait of Hormuz. That vast chasm tells the real story.
**Trump continued:** _" Remember, because of our drill baby drill program, America has plenty of gas... We produce more oil and gas than Saudi Arabia and Russia combined... We're now totally independent of the Middle East."_
This is the decisive break. For nearly half a century, American foreign policy was chained to the fear of what a Middle East crisis would do to oil prices and the economy. Every president since the 1970s danced around Iran, unwilling to confront the root of the problem because the price of gasoline at home hung over their heads like a sword of Damocles.
Trump changed that equation. His relentless push for energy independence -- drill baby drill at home and smart partnerships abroad -- has finally freed the United States from those chains. America no longer has to shape its entire Middle East strategy around the potential ripple effects on domestic pump prices. We produce more oil and gas than Saudi Arabia and Russia combined, and we are now working with Venezuela, which holds the largest untapped reserves on Earth.
* * *
_" We're working along with Venezuela and are, in a true sense, joint venture partners... We don't need their oil. We don't need anything they have. But we're there to help our allies."_ **\- President Trump - April 1st 2026**
* * *
The contrast could not be clearer. While Europe and Asia scramble as tanker traffic through the Hormuz chokepoint dries up, America stands largely insulated. The aggressive domestic energy policy combined with securing access to Venezuelan reserves has given the United States something it has not had for nearly fifty years: the freedom to act decisively in the Middle East without being held hostage by oil markets.
Trump did not create this crisis. Iran did. But because of his foresight on energy, America can now respond from a position of strength rather than desperation. Energy independence is not just an economic policy -- it is the foundation of strategic freedom.
### **32 Days That Changed the Middle East and the World**
* * *
_" It's very important that we keep this conflict in perspective. American involvement in World War I lasted one year, seven months and five days. World War II lasted for three years, eight months and 25 days... We are in this military operation, so powerful, so brilliant against one of the most powerful countries for 32 days. And the country has been eviscerated and essentially is really no longer a threat. They were the bully of the Middle East, but they are the bully no longer."_ **\- President Trump - April 1st 2026**
* * *
President Trump put current events in their proper historical scale, and Americans would do well to listen.
America has long and painful memories of wars that began with high hopes and vague (but noble) aims, only for them to drag on for years at enormous human cost. Vietnam started as limited adventurism and became an intractable quagmire. Twenty-eight years later, Iraq followed a similar path -- years of occupation, thousands of American lives lost, and outcomes that remained stubbornly elusive.
Trump's approach has been deliberately different. By relying overwhelmingly on airpower and precision strikes while showing no intention of committing hundreds of thousands of ground troops, he has achieved a level of combat success in just 32 days that previous campaigns took years to approach -- and at a fraction of the American blood and treasure.
In our 24/7 TikTok world, 32 days can feel like an eternity. But perspective matters. The Siege of Khe Sanh alone lasted 77 days -- a brutal fight over a single hill in the jungles of Vietnam. In less than half that time, Trump has essentially neutralized the biggest thorn in the side of the Middle East: a fanatical regime that sponsored terrorism, destabilized the region, and raced toward nuclear weapons.
This is not just a tactical victory. In geopolitical terms, it ranks as one of the most significant shifts in the global landscape since the fall of the Soviet Union. Iran, long the bully of the Middle East, has been eviscerated as a conventional threat in record time.
Critics may complain about the speed or the method, but the results speak clearly. A regime that terrorized its own people and its neighbors has been brought low without the endless ground commitments that defined earlier American wars. Trump has shown that decisive, limited military action focused on clear objectives can deliver strategic victories that decades of half-measures and nation-building could not.
Thirty-two days. No endless occupation. No thousands of American graves. Just a bully removed from the playground.
That is a rare and remarkable achievement.
America First has been the mantra that this administration has run on. What happened last night was America reemerging onto the world stage as the Superpower it has always been.
The most powerful nation on earth, has dragged itself out of the intractable malaise that has existed in quiet perpetuity since the failures of the Carter administration and that were prolonged by political hesitancy, it has freed it's self from the shackles of oil dependency, and now it is able to do what it does best.
Act decisively, act unilaterally, and act effectively.

Amid a nationwide reckoning over Medicaid fraud committed largely by "New Americans," Maine Gov. Janet Mills is taking the unprecedented step of freezing enrollment in four of the most defrauded programs in MaineCare.
"Effective April 13, 2026, the Office of Aging and Disability Services (OADS) is temporarily pausing acceptance and review of initial applications from entities seeking to become OADS-approved waiver providers under MaineCare Benefits Manual (MBM) Sections 18, 20, 21, and 29," the agency said in the email.
The agency's stated rationale was bureaucratic in nature: "OADS is implementing this pause to help maintain timely and consistent review of applications, which OADS receives in high volumes, and to prioritize, with OADS' limited staff resources, quality support and oversight of enrolled providers."

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..U6-5XiN-F1i8n0rs2nN_1b3BT4EmX5UBh_jJ1evFZXo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=192982052)
The move, announced by the Department of Health and Human Services' Office of Aging and Disability Services in a terse email Thursday, comes after Gov. Mills and her Democratic U.S. Senate campaign have spent weeks denying widespread Medicaid fraud in Maine and attacking the journalists and federal investigators who've exposed it.
According to a copy of the email obtained by _The Robinson Report,_ OADS will block new entrants to four MaineCare waiver programs that have been at the center of a sweeping Medicaid fraud allegations, including Section 18, Section 20, Section 21, and Section 29.
Section 21 is the program that funds autism group homes throughout the state and has attracted significant attention due to the proliferation of group home agencies owned by and staffed by Central African migrants. That includes the Portland-based [Paradise Residential Services](https://substack.com/redirect/52f40828-d72a-436b-96be-f9cfe213d88b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which DHHS recently de-authorized after its founders managed to bill more than $16 million from 2021 to 2024.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/52f40828-d72a-436b-96be-f9cfe213d88b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)| | |
#### [Maine Boots Autism Provider After $16M in Medicaid Billing, Allegations of Fraud and Abuse Emerge](https://substack.com/redirect/52f40828-d72a-436b-96be-f9cfe213d88b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
| | [The Robinson Report](https://substack.com/profile/147548156-the-robinson-report)| | *
---|---|---
| Mar 19
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/52f40828-d72a-436b-96be-f9cfe213d88b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The move is yet another indication that while Mills publicly insists there is nothing unusual to see, state bureaucrats are privately scrambling to get ahead of federal investigators who think otherwise.
In addition to probes from the U.S. House Oversight Committee and the federal Health and Human Services Office of Inspector General (OIG), Maine has also been named as among the top targets of President Donald Trump's newly incarnated welfare fraud task force, spearheaded by Vice President J.D. Vance.
A federal audit released in January 2026 found that the federal government made at least $45.6 million in improper MaineCare payments for autism services in 2023 alone. As Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services Administrator Dr. Mehmet Oz bluntly noted, "one hundred percent of the claims examined had problems."
That's not a rounding error. That's a systemic failure.
The House Oversight probe is particularly focused on whether Maine illegally caused the federal government to reimburse that state for services provided to non-citizens.
Under Mills, the Democrat-controlled legislature has twice expanded MaineCare -- once inline with provisions of the Affordable Care Act (aka ObamaCare), which added tens of thousands of childless able-bodied adults to the welfare program, then again in 2022 with legislation that added more non-citizens to MaineCare.
The four sections being frozen are not obscure administrative backwaters. Together, these programs represent the largest They represent the core of Maine's home and community-based services infrastructure for some of its most vulnerable residents. Section 18 covers home and community-based services for adults with traumatic brain injuries. Section 20 covers services for adults with other related conditions. Section 21 covers home and community benefits for adults with intellectual disabilities or autism spectrum disorder. Section 29 provides support services for adults with intellectual disabilities or autism.
All of these programs have skyrocketed in cost under Mills, especially following the expansion of Medicaid services to a broader class of noncitizens.

There’s no time to waste. Thank you for your support, Eugene Vindman Congressman, VA-07

| | Peter –

Right now, essential workers across the Department of Homeland Security are being caught in the middle of political dysfunction.

TSA agents are stretched thin. FEMA staff are working without pay. Coast Guard workers are still showing up every day without knowing when their next paycheck will come.

And for what?

Instead of working toward a real solution, House leadership is bringing the same partisan proposals to the floor – proposals that have already failed and do nothing to reopen DHS or support the people who keep our country running.

That’s not leadership.

I also introduced a bill to ensure essential workers get paid during shutdowns by redirecting already-approved, unused funds.

clean_body: | | Peter – Right now, essential workers across the Department of Homeland Security are being caught in the middle of political dysfunction. TSA agents are stretched thin. FEMA staff are working without pay. Coast Guard workers are still showing up every day without knowing when their next paycheck will come. And for what? I also introduced a bill to ensure essential workers get paid during shutdowns by redirecting already-approved, unused funds. This is common sense. We can keep people safe and treat workers fairly at the same time. subject: What today’s Tina Peters ruling means
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Amanda for Colorado
body:
| | | Hi Peter, Today, the Colorado Court of Appeals upheld every one of Tina Peters' convictions, including all four felonies. In fact, they said the evidence that she knew what she was doing was illegal was, “overwhelming.” The court also sent her case back for a new sentencing hearing. It found that her election-denier commentary may have influenced how long her sentence was. The next question for the court is whether or not that's true. **Here's what this means going forward: the conviction stands.** A new sentencing hearing will determine how much time she serves. It remains vital that those who willfully aim to undermine the security and integrity of our elections face accountability. In prison, **Tina Peters is facing the consequences of her actions, and that's where she should stay.** Colorado's elections are secure. But **security takes vigilance and expertise.** It takes people who know the law, who will enforce it and who are ready for what comes next. The next executive order. The next inside actor. The next pressure campaign from Washington. I live and breathe election law. I'm the experienced candidate. The expert who's leading this race by a 26-point margin. And I'm running to defend our democracy. Colorado needs a firewall, not a figurehead, to fight for you. To do that, **I need you to fight with me.** We're days away from our next fundraising deadline and have to keep the momentum on our side. Your participation in anything we do helps move those efforts forward, and I am always grateful for your support. Be sure to sign up for one and if you already have, check your email soon for the new instructions!
_Volunteer Spotlight:_
This month we are highlighting our new Texas state party chair, **Brandon David**! He has taken over the reigns and continued to lead the charge and we are so grateful. When asked why he volunteers for Forward Party, this is what he said: "My motivation to roll-up my sleeves here at Forward is my two kiddos: Teeny (9) and Miles (6). I was pulled into Forward thanks to Andrew and the Yang Gang, but moved to act by the sense of urgency I feel as a concerned parent. Driven to get divisiveness and hate out of politics, I've got my heart set on making things better, in TX and the US, by the time my kiddos are old enough to vote." Thank you so much, Brandon!

name: Scott Presler
subject: The SAVE America Act would save the midterms, but not if the Senate doesn’t pass it
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Early Vote Action PAC
body:
The real election protection plan starts right here
| Patriot, I'll be honest with you. I've been watching the debate over the SAVE America Act in Washington — and while I'm cheering for it to pass, I've been in this fight long enough to know something most people won't say: **We cannot afford to wait on Washington to save our elections.** While politicians debate, the Democrat ground game does not stop. Their voter registration staffers are at their tables right now. Their ballot chasers are making their calls. Their door knockers are hitting their lists. _And if we are not doing the same thing — right now — we are falling behind._ **I know this because I've lived it.** In 2024, my team spent over a year embedded on the ground in Pennsylvania before Election Day. We helped register hundreds of thousands of new Republican voters. We chased down every outstanding mail-in ballot we legally could. We drove voters to the polls on Election Day. **That is why Pennsylvania went red.** Not because of any law. Not because of any court ruling. supposed to be automatic. Our loyalty, assumed. No persuasion
required.

My father hid our family in a fishing boat in 1985. Three days at sea
to escape a communist government that told people what to think, who
to support, and what they were allowed to say. We arrived in
Huntington Beach in 1987. Dad had $20 in his pocket.

I didn’t survive a communist government to let any political party
tell me how to think.

The moment an Asian woman stands up as a Republican — campaigns on
lower taxes, secure borders, and individual freedom — the attacks
begin. Not policy debates. Not arguments. Personal attacks, designed
to put me back in the box they built for people who look like me.

“You’re supposed to be Democrat.”
“You’re betraying your community.”
“You’re a token.”

I hear it. My supporters hear it. My Vietnamese neighbors hear it. And
every time I hear it, I think about that fishing boat. About what it
actually looks like when a government controls what you’re allowed
to believe.

subject: Upholding election integrity
body:
| | Peter –

Last week, the Supreme Court heard arguments in a case that could fundamentally change how we vote here in Washington.

The Court’s decision could end the long-standing practice of counting mail-in ballots that are postmarked by Election Day but arrive afterward – a system that thousands of Washingtonians rely on every election.

I’ll be blunt, Peter: I don’t think we should be making it harder for folks to vote, especially when what we’ve built here in Washington already works.

[If you agree we should protect vote-by-mail and keep our elections accessible and secure, will you add your name today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128657191/611931547/1999362415?refcode=MGP_EM_PT_90DO_260402_1_1&refcode2=47ceda25-c62e-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTkyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0N2NlZGEyNS1jNjJlLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3s5Qs4ZwOEvgqKZqNAg1eFTM0-N6oYwaQr7nabaiZMA=&emci=56ff30b4-c32e-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&emdi=47ceda25-c62e-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=31138575)

Experts agree that Washington’s vote-by-mail system is the gold standard in elections. It’s secure and trusted, and it ensures that working people, rural communities, veterans, seniors, and folks with disabilities can participate in our democracy.

And here’s the reality: thousands of voters follow the rules and still have their ballots arrive after Election Day, especially in rural areas or during postal delays. **Throwing those ballots out wouldn’t make our elections safer – it would just silence voters who did everything by the book.**

That’s what I’m fighting for, and I need to know you’re with me.** [Add your name to stand up for vote-by-mail today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128657193/611931549/1999362415?refcode=MGP_EM_PT_90DO_260402_1_1&refcode2=47ceda25-c62e-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTkyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0N2NlZGEyNS1jNjJlLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3s5Qs4ZwOEvgqKZqNAg1eFTM0-N6oYwaQr7nabaiZMA=&emci=56ff30b4-c32e-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&emdi=47ceda25-c62e-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=31138575)

body:
Federal order puts Colorado’s mail ballot system on a collision course
| | | | [](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
| | Hi friends,
✡️ Happy Passover to all who celebrate—wishing you a meaningful and joyful holiday as you gather with family and friends.

Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.joinrmv.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv.). And also, check out our [deep-dive video of the day](https://link.email.joinrmv.) on the new federal election order.
Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏛️ **Under the Golden Dome...** Lawmakers face a [$1.5 billion shortfall following last year’s deficit](https://link.email.joinrmv.), even as state spending has surged more than 43% since 2019, with debate growing over [spending priorities](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and long-term fiscal sustainability.

🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** The U.S. Supreme Court [struck down the state’s “conversion therapy” ban](https://link.email.joinrmv.) in an 8-1 free speech ruling, while officials warn [wildfire conditions may be worse than past major fire seasons](https://link.email.joinrmv.) amid ongoing drought. A federal judge also [upheld Colorado’s sanctuary laws](https://link.email.joinrmv.), and a new federal election order could [force major changes to the state’s mail ballot system](https://link.email.joinrmv.), raising concerns about implementation and voter access—while election integrity advocates say it could strengthen verification of voter rolls. Questions about media coverage are also drawing attention after commentary argued that some [outlets omitted key immigration details](https://link.email.joinrmv.).
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Election integrity efforts are advancing as President Trump ordered the [creation of verified voter lists](https://link.email.joinrmv.) tied to mail-in ballots, while the a new commentary [explores the SAVE America Act](https://link.email.joinrmv.), arguing such measures align with existing identification requirements used by lawmakers themselves.
This is your Mountain Minute for Thursday, April 2, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Federal order puts Colorado’s mail ballot system on a collision course](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
The way Colorado runs elections hasn’t changed—but a new federal order could force it to.
The order would have federal agencies assemble a nationwide list of verified U.S. citizens and share it with state election officials.
States could then choose to send their own voter lists to the U.S. Postal Service about 60 days before an election. If they do, ballots would be limited to the names on those lists.
In Colorado, that framework could fundamentally change how elections work.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**[The Plain Truth Behind Voter ID, the SAVE America Act and Election Integrity](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY RUSS MINARY, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **SAVE Act would require proof of citizenship to vote:** The proposal mandates documentary proof of U.S. citizenship for federal voter registration and requires states to remove noncitizens from voter rolls.
* **Supporters compare it to existing ID requirements:** The article notes that members of Congress must present identification to vote, arguing similar standards for voters would strengthen election security and integrity.
* **Broad public support cited despite ongoing debate:** The piece points to polling showing 70–80% support for voter ID measures and argues such requirements are common in everyday activities, countering claims they are overly burdensome.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
|
---
**[Colorado Legislative Malpractice](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY CORY GAINES, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Commentary warns of “legislative malpractice” in state policy:** The piece argues Colorado’s policies are increasingly driven by ideology over long-term stability, leading to gradual economic and fiscal strain.
* **Business climate and regulatory burden under scrutiny:** It highlights growing regulatory complexity, labor mandates, and uncertainty as factors making Colorado a more difficult place for businesses—particularly small and mid-sized employers—to operate.
* **Long-term fiscal risks tied to spending and structural issues:** The article points to rising government obligations, unfunded pension liabilities, and the expanded use of fees as revenue sources as signs of potential long-term instability if current trends continue.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[When “Protecting Seniors” Meets Fiscal Reality: A Self-Inflicted Crisis](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
**[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)****BY REP. KEN DEGRAAF | COMMENTARY | MARCH 31** _Any legislator who has opened their inbox lately has seen the urgent appeals: AARP warning that Colorado’s Senior Homestead Property Tax Exemption is under threat. The message is emotionally compelling—and fundamentally correct. Eliminating or weakening the exemption would amount to a tax increase on seniors, many of whom live on fixed incomes after decades of contributing to their communities._
__
**[Grassroots or guided? Inside the ‘No Kings’ protests in Colorado](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
**[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)****BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | MARCH 31** _A large crowd gathered at the Colorado State Capitol on Saturday before marching through downtown Denver — the third installment of a movement its organizers describe on their national website as a grassroots uprising, “spreading from small towns to city centers and across every community determined to defend democracy.” Denver was one of many across the state._
__
**[Denver in Decline](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
**[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)****BY TOM ANTHONY | COMMENTARY | MARCH 30** _My great grandpa excavated Federal Blvd and Colfax with mules and a scraper, his dad having been on the third wagon train into Denver in 1858. For many years I owned and developed Denver property out of the commitment: “Sustainable Cities People Love,” my company motto._
__

| | | | | I tell it how it is.

It's President Trump's strongest ally, Byron Donalds, and I can't believe what just happened after I dropped a MAGA Truth bomb.

Here was my message to the so-far wrong Democrats crying that most Americans wanted to be in Free states like Florida, rather than suffer under their HORRIBLE policies:

You get what you deserve.

**Your policies are radical.
Your taxes are unbearable.
Your leadership is tyrannical.**

Not a single thing I said is up for debate, and it's why these Radical Democrats are pouring their heart and soul into convincing people that MAGA is done..

They know that NOBODY wants to suffer under their leadership, so they're trying to FORCE it upon them.

That's why the attacks against me have been **NON-STOP** and **BRUTAL.**

LYING about my name, President Trump, and ALL of MAGA.

It's the only way these people can rally a crowd, by SMEARING all of MAGA.

I don't listen to all the noise, but their liberal billionaire buddies do; they'll open their checkbook if they smell weakness.

Florida is MAGA's home turf, and Democrats want to STEAL it at all costs. That's why MILLIONS are being spent against me to force my surrender.

If I lose this race, Florida will turn into New York City, a **[DISASTER](https://links.trueamericanconservatives.com/s/c/3snCkNkrSsSBdSHLH3YkpctGjPGIVv__wNNNjoMDB-TQNqCI_GID2G4-1tbMfTC5D2w_HVAfsxmJmpQQeb4_oTZtOEL-3pvRSctpuqD3lVaVm2nG9_hlUCWndJodkZSTEh08uXzypTylttRS_snkpbghUFOAAk84F_LYbQjrL5GFAjwyPg95MrZMA3i_YlW3P2kGx3v3a8HMd1ivB_1vuXl3UCc0ZN_4RcoTQjEgnSKyoFCPBD5Dq6vaUOTdGVJi2Tnj7SYHL58TQl8-5_8pg2zwTbWQ8mJJIlLfIaHvf8HpAShkTKHoUDlwocBXNRrDoC2QD30XUrhKi4HstJ90bhBRhk5nmp8bfThmjtTecl8rYJhCmU1k_GbkEhmg_hac0xXTbXWz7Oh91vXVqRGGpT0eBjTCv1J4yGn6zJLmOjLz0Rj68tUe6-BeUghHitDJVkf8x0YSL8IIjRngW4vCfyq9hRa0ijBtnjC_nhfU5fP0_n_PlCAmWD5Kmndy1SYdhlMgIuu6XHbp0wLXLA6Q4Y8ElAi4kpQWAXx4uJZeyUU8K2-6J0dgL6Nwb_vOcWaNKtqWSR0-oDvgNxTU87Z7pu44hg7ZCZLfRvG_WoLGaXpUQEvMC0EtQPVvSf9C/JqlQCxbdp68nWUq00jNyP_9ezkLm2SkT/19 "DISASTER")** run by Far-Left Socialists who want nothing more than to spread their radical agenda to the Sunshine State.

_**Let 's make sure that doesn't happen.**_

You've never abandoned me, and I'm humbly asking you to step up again, because I am only in this fight because of MAGA patriots like yourself.
---

---
| | | As much as I'd like to say the Democrats are finished, they aren't.

Every time we think they're as good as gone, they come back, and with my primary less than five months away, we can't afford for that to happen.

If we make the mistake of taking them lightly, MAGA could be as good as gone, because they have UNLIMITED FUNDS and they've already dumped MILLIONS into this race.

**There 's nothing these people want to do more than force my surrender and then come for YOU next.**

With you by my side, we'll stop them right in their tracks.

We'll keep Florida MAGA's home turf and deliver ANOTHER victory for President Trump.

These opportunities are being taken away from families like mine today – and they hurt us all.

That’s why I’m fighting in Congress to protect funding for lifelines like these, but without a Democratic House majority, holding the Trump Administration accountable is nearly impossible.

Derek
