subject: Friend, the crowds are coming and so are traffickers
body:
Before the big race, we’re preparing to protect vulnerable children across Louisville.

| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e15208507/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvZXREUEVUdUN4bQ/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA0MDI/LbmNsNFpMUzdvag/qP2hpZHM9bmNFbThTajlxY21lalBscw/gac7CAQ/s6m1e6c5f8f)
| |
---
| |
---
| GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | Friend, Soon Louisville will come alive. Bright floral hats. Mint juleps in hand. Crowds dressed in their finest. And the thunder of hooves racing toward the finish line. **It’s a time of celebration. A tradition. A moment people wait all year for.**
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
But behind the music, the laughter and the packed hotels, there is another race happening. A darker one. Because when hundreds of thousands of visitors arrive, traffickers arrive too. They move quietly.
They hide in plain sight.
And vulnerable children can become targets. Human trafficking is now one of the fastest-growing crimes in our nation. And events like this create the perfect cover. Busy hotels. Constant movement. Strangers everywhere. That’s why, _before the first horse ever leaves the gate_ , we’re taking action.
---
[ Help Protect Children Before Race Day ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Across Louisville, volunteers are stepping forward. **Ordinary people, just like you.** They are being trained to spot the warning signs of trafficking and to understand what is happening right in their own city. To refuse to look away. Then, together, they prepare simple but powerful tools. Soap. Makeup remover wipes.
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Each one labeled with the national human trafficking hotline.
**A lifeline.**
**A whisper of hope.** These kits are delivered to hotels and motels across the city. **Placed quietly. But with great purpose.** Because sometimes, a child sees that number and realizes escape is possible. The Sound of Freedom Foundation is a faith-driven movement on a mission to ** _stop the sale of God’s children_. ** We support the front lines. We work closely to prevent trafficking, equip rescue efforts, and train everyday people to recognize the signs, so children can be protected before exploitation happens. The **Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists for this reason. **To stop the sale of God’s children.**
---
[ Help Protect Children Before Race Day ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
After producing _Sound of Freedom_ , I knew awareness was not enough. Real children still needed protection. So this mission continues through real action: **Preventing exploitation.**
**Supporting rescue efforts.**
**Equipping communities.** **And bringing light into the darkest places.** Jesus said, “ _Whoever welcomes one little child like this in my name welcomes me.”_ (Matthew 18:5) As the city prepares for celebration, we must prepare for protection. Because once the crowds arrive, the window to act begins to close. This is our moment. Before the race, the crowds and before traffickers fully move in. Will you help us with a donation of $25, $60, $120 or whatever you’re able to do today to help reach more hotels, equip more volunteers, and reach more children who may be waiting for hope?
---
[ Help Protect Children Before Race Day ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Your gift today can help: **$60 — Equip one outreach visit**
**$120 — Supply life-saving materials**
**$180 — Expand outreach across multiple hotels**
**$240 — Multiply protection before peak crowds arrive** Imagine, amid the cheers, the celebration, the roses and the race, a child finds a way out. **Because someone like you chose to act.** **Please give as generously as you can today and please pray for every volunteer walking into those hotels and for every child who needs rescue.** **Because God’s children are not for sale.** And together, we will run this race to protect them. With gratitude and prayer,
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Eduardo Verástegui
Sound of Freedom, Producer
For the Sound of Freedom Foundation
---
[ Support the Sound of Freedom Foundation ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074
---

108 S Washington St. Suite 200
Alexandria, VA 22314

* * *
_**by Ellie Leonard, Blue Amp Media Contributing Editor**_
We've spent much of the past 15 months or so learning as a society how to compartmentalize terrible news. Whether it's wars, or land-grabs, or violent claims of religious and/or colonial rights impeding on human rights, we do our best to use our voices, our money, our platform, our feet, and our numbers, to make some kind of a dent in the compounding problems coming from Washington and predatory "allies" from around the world. And we can't do it all. Most of us focus in on the area in which we feel we can make the biggest difference. For some that's ICE and immigration rights. For others it's combating poverty when food stamps and healthcare are ripped away from the most vulnerable. It's the importance of local politics and understanding our rights and what we're really voting for at the end of the day.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/290fab16-7a39-4530-8007-79066380894f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* * *
For me it's been the Epstein Files. I don't know that I necessarily picked that path, but it seems to have chosen me, nearly eaten me up at times, but I still have my head above water and hope that a single thing that I might say or do will make some small difference in the course of this investigation and the lives of those involved.
But as I sit back and look at these files, I can't help but notice the parallels, things that seem to align with the story of hundreds of girls and a club of wealthy older men.
Before I do one of those "fade to the 1990s" effects, I'd like to share a moment of clarity I had a few months back when talking to a friend, another writer, who has focused on these ideas much longer than I. We both wrote books, hers about growing up in the Church of Christ and following the path of faith through college and relationships, and mine as an evangelical kid, a homeschooler, long hair and the whole bit. I'd written books about what I called "rural narratives"--young girls growing up in isolated small towns where the church shaped their every move. Hers, while fiction, is a little more autobiographical; but I always claimed my characters weren't based on me. I'd made them up, simple as that. But on the third or four edit you suddenly feel the twinge--I think this is me I'm writing about. Maybe not as drastic. Maybe not as tragic. But this kid is certainly built on a world that I know well.
"It's purity culture," she told me. I had no idea what that meant.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/290fab16-7a39-4530-8007-79066380894f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* * *
We spent the next however many months discussing father-daughter promise rings and dances, oaths of abstinence, no kissing, no hand-holding, no makeup, long skirts, baggy clothes, no sex before marriage, and always, _always_ remember that boys can't help themselves. It was our job to protect ourselves. I remember being told it was a good idea to wear bulky underwear under dresses, so boys didn't think I had nothing on. Because of course they were always looking.
To be clear, this didn't all come from family. I was surrounded by a world that told me a similar story. And with that came another darker side of purity that we now know goes hand-in-hand for most young girls: eating disorders. Not only did girls have to stay young, pure, and sweet, but they couldn't be overweight either. Beauty mattered. It was our responsibility.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/290fab16-7a39-4530-8007-79066380894f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

[Leave a comment](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=192918499&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&isFreemail=true&comments=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkyOTE4NDk5LCJpYXQiOjE3NzUxNTgzMTYsImV4cCI6MTc3Nzc1MDMxNiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.w9JjaShBCXaeFzDWs1GSbHpr5FLCJ5H6gn5s3dxYwCI&r=1hvr60&utm_campaign=email-half-magic-comments&action=post-comment)
* * *
It wasn't just me. It wasn't just my friends. It was nearly every Millennial and Gen X, and probably all the girls before that. And with it came the statistics of nearly one in four girls being sexually abused, despite "protecting" themselves by staying sweet, or staying thin, or not holding anyone's hand.
And try though they might to protect themselves, it wasn't the girls abusing anyone. Sexual abuse is at the hands of men 92-99% of the time. And yet the responsibility of purity culture very rarely fell into their hands. But when it did, it always turned out badly.

What if they have to go on maternity leave? | | ---|---|--- I could go on, but my word count is getting a little out of control. In summary, purity culture is often the reason for the season behind a story about powerful men and children from poor homes who would do almost anything for $200 because it's stability, and food, and rent. Yet we blame the girls for prostitution. We blame them for sex. We blame them for their bodies, their choices, their jobs, their looks, their mistakes. And yet the worst we can do on their behalf is take away a Prince's pretend title, force a few CEOs into early retirement to spend on their yachts and private islands, and sniff around 8000 acres that 30 years later we can't be bothered to search for a few dead kids. Ellie is an author, editor, and owner of, and works with filmmakers, podcasts, and journalists all over the world. She lives with her family just outside of New York City. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The most famous line most of us learned as children is not "freedom." It is not "strength." It is not even "democracy."
It is this: **liberty and justice for all.**
That line is small enough to memorize in second grade and large enough to govern a nation. It is the moral center of the whole American project. It is the claim that power is supposed to be restrained, that rights are supposed to be real, and that human dignity is not reserved for the popular, the wealthy, the native-born, the well-connected, or the politically useful.
And yet this is where the nation drifts. We keep the words and abandon the meaning. We repeat the promise while building exceptions into it. We say "for all," then quietly mean: for people like us. For people we approve of. For people who can afford a lawyer. For people who are easy to defend at a dinner party.
So if we want a usable civic standard -- one ordinary people can carry into a classroom, a school board meeting, a city council hearing, a jury box, a voting booth, a conversation with our children -- we need a test.
Not a partisan test. A constitutional one.
Here are the four tests.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a1eaf542-8047-41e4-8eac-e4033504d837?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The first test is this:
_**Does it still apply to the unpopular?**_
This is where most hypocrisy reveals itself.
It is easy to defend rights for people we like. Easy to insist on fairness for the sympathetic, the familiar, the respectable. The real test is what we do when the person in question is disliked, foreign, accused, politically inconvenient, culturally different, poor, awkward, or easy to scapegoat.
A principle is not a principle if it disappears the moment it becomes costly.
If free speech is only for people whose views flatter us, it is not free speech. If due process is only for people with clean biographies and good public relations, it is not due process. If dignity belongs only to those who have never frightened, offended, or disappointed us, then it is not dignity. It is reward.
A free country does not sort human beings into "real people" and "exceptions."
The unpopular still count. Especially then.
The second test is this:
_**Does it restrain the powerful?**_
This is the constitutional question.
The point of rights is not to adorn the weak. The point of rights is to bind the strong.
Any government can praise liberty in the abstract. The real question is whether liberty still has force when it inconveniences the people with the badge, the budget, the office, the contract, the title, the donor list, the command structure, or the institutional prestige.
Does the law still bind those who enforce it?
Can a public official be checked when they overreach?
Can an agency be challenged when it acts in secrecy, delay, intimidation, or procedural abuse?
Can wealth buy a different level of justice than an ordinary person receives?
The American promise was never that we would be ruled by good people forever. It was that power itself would be limited. That ambition would counter ambition. That government would derive legitimacy from law and consent, not fear. That the people would not be left defenseless before institutions too large to question.
If a policy expands state power without building in accountability, oversight, review, and remedy, we should be deeply suspicious of it.
If the strong are freer than the weak, then liberty is already leaking out of the system.
The third test is this:
_**Does it survive fear?**_
This may be the hardest one.
Because fear is where free societies tell on themselves.
When people are calm, they praise principle. When people are frightened, they reveal what they actually believe. Fear is when rights become "complicated." It is when exceptions multiply. It is when due process starts being described as a luxury. It is when cruelty gets rebranded as necessity. It is when neighbors are taught to see one another not as fellow human beings, but as categories of risk.
This pattern is as old as power itself.
A crisis arrives. Or one is manufactured. Or one is exaggerated for profit and control. Then comes the argument that we must move fast, ask fewer questions, trust the authorities, suspend ordinary protections, and sort out the damage later.
But a right that exists only in calm weather is not a right. It is a fair-weather custom.
The whole point of constitutional restraint is that it survives panic.
The whole point of equal protection is that it does not evaporate when rumor is loud, when propaganda is profitable, or when a frightened public is being tempted to trade principle for the illusion of safety.
Fear is real. Threats are real. Government has legitimate responsibilities. But a free society does not answer fear by hollowing out the very safeguards that make it free.
If a policy requires panic to sell itself, look closer.
The fourth test is this:
_**Does it protect the falsely accused?**_
This is where justice becomes real.
Every serious legal tradition understands this: once a system stops caring whether innocent people are swept up, the system itself becomes dangerous.
False accusation is not a side issue. It is one of the central civic nightmares. Because once process no longer matters, anyone can be reduced to paperwork, rumor, suspicion, convenience, or narrative need. Once accusation becomes enough, the burden of proof quietly shifts from the state to the person trying to survive it.
That is not justice. That is administrative violence.
A decent society must be built so that innocence has somewhere to stand. That means notice. Hearing. Evidence. Counsel. Review. Transparency. The ability to confront allegations. The ability to appeal abuse. The right not to disappear into a maze of procedure while officials shrug and call it normal.
This is not softness. It is civilization.
The falsely accused matter because truth matters. And because every power in history, once given room to act first and explain later, has eventually used that room too broadly, too carelessly, or too cruelly.
If a system cannot distinguish the dangerous from the innocent without trampling both, then the system is the danger.
So that is the framework:
**Does it apply to the unpopular?**
**Does it restrain the powerful?**
**Does it survive fear?**
**Does it protect the falsely accused?**
That is not everything we need for a just society. But it is enough to reveal a great deal.
Enough to judge a law.
Enough to judge a public narrative.
Enough to judge a candidate.
Enough to judge an institution.
Enough to teach a child what freedom is actually for.
And maybe that is the most important part.
_We should be teaching this on purpose._
We should teach our children that "for all" means **no asterisks**. We should teach them that rights are most sacred when they are hardest to defend. We should teach them that patriotism is not obedience to institutions, but fidelity to the constitutional promise beneath them. We should teach them that the government's job is not to select targets, but to secure dignity, safety, and opportunity for the people. We should teach them that the measure of a country is not how proudly it speaks of liberty, but how faithfully it practices it under pressure.
Because this beautiful nation is not finished.
It is still being decided, over and over, by what we tolerate, what we excuse, what we defend, and what we refuse.
"Liberty and justice for all" is not a sentimental line from childhood. It is a test we are still taking.
And the good news is that ordinary people can still grade the paper.

Share it with someone who still wants this country to mean what it says.

**Friend — Pam Bondi has been FIRED from her job as Attorney General.**
[**This is a massive victory for our movement, and before I go any further, I’m asking you to chip in $10 to help us keep up the pressure and use this moment to build even more progressive power >>**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-apr26.yEIO3a&refcode=em260402-1-210&t=2&akid=2154%2E791427%2Eisg2yt)

Simply put, Pam Bondi was a disaster as Attorney General.
Her mishandling of the Epstein Files alone was enough to get her the boot, or even face impeachment. She violated the law passed by Congress to give cover to Trump and their billionaire buddies. She put the reputations of the rich and powerful over justice for the victims and accountability for the perpetrators. And in the process, she lied to the American people.
Her Epstein cover-up was emblematic of her entire tenure at the Department of Justice. Her job wasn’t to fight for the American people, it was to protect Trump from legal consequences at all costs and go after his enemies when he said the word.
Sham investigations, unsupported charges, conflicts of interest, and political maneuvering became the status quo under her leadership, and the entire American justice system is worse off as a result. I should know — I have been the target of such sham investigations for months now.
**But here’s the good news: Our organizing worked.**
I have no doubt in my mind that our constant pressure campaign for accountability from this administration led to Pam Bondi losing her job today. It’s how we forced out Kristi Noem, and how we will continue to notch more victories against this corrupt President and his disregard for our Constitution.

body:

Friends,
The numbers haven’t changed—and that’s the problem.
In 2026, women hold just 28% of seats in Congress , the same as the previous session. At the state level, it’s only 33.5% .
Despite making up half the population, women are still vastly underrepresented in the rooms where decisions are made.
Women are effective leaders. They communicate, collaborate, and deliver results. The real barrier is access—who gets recruited, trained, and supported to run in the first place.
Because leadership doesn’t start in Washington.
Nearly 70% of House members and 82% of Senators began in local or state office. And too often, women are never given the tools or encouragement to take that first step.
Emerge doesn’t wait until women are already candidates. We invest early. We recruit, train, and connect Democratic women to the networks they need to run—and win. That’s why our first-time candidates are six times more likely to win their races, and we had a 77% win rate in last year’s election.
But building that pipeline takes resources. And right now, the need couldn’t be more urgent.

clean_body: [] Friends, The numbers haven’t changed—and that’s the problem. In 2026, women hold just 28% of seats in Congress , the same as the previous session. At the state level, it’s only 33.5% . Despite making up half the population, women are still vastly underrepresented in the rooms where decisions are made. Women are effective leaders. They communicate, collaborate, and deliver results. The real barrier is access—who gets recruited, trained, and supported to run in the first place. Because leadership doesn’t start in Washington. subject: Grateful
body:
|
#
Friend, I’m so grateful you’re in this fight with me. **Because of your support, we didn’t just finish the first quarter of 2026 strong – we _exceeded_ our fundraising goal and raised over $1 million. That’s a big deal, especially right now.** As we speak, the GOP is airing bogus ads attacking me to flip this seat. But the numbers we’re reporting send a clear message: this campaign is strong, it’s growing, and we’re not backing down. And friend, we both know – it’s only going to get tougher from here. As we get closer to Election Day, the attacks will ramp up. That’s what happens in a district like ours that could decide control of Congress. But even in the face of these attacks, I’ve remained focused on fighting for mid-Michiganders. Right now, working families are being forced to deal with the rising prices of food and fuel – and it’s taking a toll. Folks are already stretched thin, and they need someone in their corner who understands what they’re up against and is ready to fight to make things better, no matter what. Friend, I came to Washington to solve these problems – and I intend to keep taking on the tough fights, standing up for what’s right, and continuing to deliver real results for folks here in MI-08. Thank you for standing with me. I couldn’t do this without you. Folks are already stretched thin, and they need someone in their corner who understands what they’re up against and is ready to fight to make things better, no matter what. Friend, I came to Washington to solve these problems – and I intend to keep taking on the tough fights, standing up for what’s right, and continuing to deliver real results for folks here in MI-08. Thank you for standing with me. I couldn’t do this without you. Kristen | = | We'd hate to see you go, but you can click here if you'd like to . Peter,

I'm the only U.S. Senate candidate in America that speaks this way. I don't take money from AIPAC or the Muslim Brotherhood. I'm probably on a CCP watchlist and the DC uniparty says I'm "unqualified", which is the best endorsement I could hope for in America. We have to rally this country, right here, right now.

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=e82887fe4f31497a96a4410b8e721156&_e=rMFuuYjKEdQ-ReEyA8rnB4Oxxcaqq0BbrsFyoeJXdAjd8lmPBZEOfJwYDqTK589UDpf6PqzdjNdeUG3eyPG7Baajkje9RQqtzzXwneYEDs7VwhAnF918mXl8p4jEk9bRpkINNSrM37LpEYhDU1DVyF5SazjE5pdFOFBvoNGMP6-hO1DZuWAZiNm6GrKatfWwIN4LMaPWjZtgJz_13_rY7yGPT3nOV48-e6qvAWvCFmps5VXALBK4QAIK4dStaGCyP_xYCBJsnrri7ePoYPxOBoyiQiNszP5rN9TuV0iFARh6jJHdR0Y9W5yIZw3KZgGRRrxzR1Q4qVlnRht6DdIDt_yBdQFgmcse2odEW3lP04pHKN7XaTSopESc4MsPzsaMAV_6aN926KeT5cw9naysTIqA8_qYotZU6xOYvK0Ia1CxsM09nsp6g3p_jSiQ_6YFLgQ4RfffKRwoNy5rCqdSzjW17Y95lWgEu2bPlP719UwvZZ_HFdHSbNkW_0fuT1sWRdsm_LbZ5cHE3fk3CqX7vVwEZcBdPcx_2_ziHgSwhoo%3D)
We may have to start a new party with this idea in the foundations, but I'd much rather save The Republican Party. Why? I genuinely believe in the philosophy of Republicanism. The fundamental issue in America is certainly a 2 party system that is perverted and corrupted beyond recognition. Maybe beyond salvaging, but... A core component of that decay is the size of government itself and more importantly the administrative leviathan that powers it. A basic yet almost unquantifiable difference between the Republican Party and Democratic Party is Democrats have conceded to the infinite expansion of the federal government as a principle. The Republicans, at least in theory and for show, still pretend we believe in shrinking the government. Right now, I don't know how many Republicans really believe in that. We must starve and strangle this leviathan and the corruption that undergirds it.

I'm trying to help this party and our country through the mechanisms we have... if we fail to rally behind good ideas things are going to get bad. Right now the Republican Party seems much more interested in Forever Wars and Legacy Media than America. Which is obviously a losing position politically and maybe militarily. Maybe that's the whole point, throw the ball back and forth with We The People as the monkey in the middle. Gavin Newsom? Really? Is anybody else sick of this crap? **[Drop a $10 donation if you see the intention.](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=e82887fe4f31497a96a4410b8e721156&_e=rMFuuYjKEdQ-ReEyA8rnB4Oxxcaqq0BbrsFyoeJXdAjd8lmPBZEOfJwYDqTK589UDpf6PqzdjNdeUG3eyPG7Baajkje9RQqtzzXwneYEDs7VwhAnF918mXl8p4jEk9bRFQ-EEhOJTp-biEoV7DzEyJxCKhbt2dckjgHGG1UaVnUVtOTTaWVo1huK9sYRPND0SJDncoylSL2cZWJfQi9NSxNiI6iQUzufRr5Ou33_nmfJGBrEoHnJICDSTFiiTub3InByBuG7fdwAlpIbR-ctmHdL2IzB2mzardt6Z-thYs_j6wWXfUuLin2d4q5MpUDiWrXI28fBhN0o2YhiSZ9zsqpLxjq-PxraGt05y5rmHHbZjIw6zlIUBQf5ZIju3WN8YekDBXXA3Qxp6pT7qJ1BM6KtXMvS3bDz72hEH2xhUJ-uytVe4easjhRwqlrsQCH2JTscureGbYaKOhY-0dXfuj3sFDpzElEePgjBKCkQI_kohLAl2A1tilJd8XUjt6_ss7QKBKTBXcyWo5CPT8qxl8WyOv8HSScMHjD_pkL_ItEPkK1b3XAThDl3O5OSqgkH)**

I continue to pray we can find a rally point of common sense, it was never going to be easy. Anybody pretending President Trump didn't open the door is being dishonest, anybody who can't bring themselves to question ANYTHING he decides has given up their citizenship. President Trump needs us to speak up and be ready to support some very tough decisions ahead, and it isn't a war in Iran, it's the constitutional crisis coming to secure elections in November. Or we will lose everything. Maybe nobody or not enough people really care anymore... That's the Greek tragedy. That's the 1984 orwellian doom! We deserve better, we can be better.

subject: Thoughts and prayers

body:
Pam Bondi gutted the DOJ, protected abusers, and did Trump’s bidding for over a year. Turns out that still wasn’t enough for him.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260402-1&t=1&akid=3326%2E587540%2E8T4I0J)
Peter,
The news just broke: **Pam Bondi has been fired.**
And honestly? Good riddance.
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260402_1_bondi.JxUtqM&refcode=em20260402-3326&t=2&akid=3326%2E587540%2E8T4I0J)
Pam Bondi spent over a year doing Trump’s bidding. She gutted the Justice Department, dismantling the units that went after corporate fraud, antitrust violations, and financial crimes that hurt working people every single day.
On top of that, she spent her time in office trying to weaponize the federal government against Trump’s “political enemies.”
And then there’s her egregious betrayal of the Epstein survivors. She chose to shield abusive men in power from accountability instead of fighting for the people they harmed.
This has been the theme of her entire career. Protecting powerful people and special interests instead of working people.
Today, it finally caught up with her.
Not because of any of the awful things I just talked about — but because _Trump didn’t think she went far enough._
He wants someone even more willing to look the other way while corporations, billionaires, and lobbyists run the table, and even more willing to use the power of the Attorney General’s office to carry out his whims.
This is the system we’re fighting against. Not just one person, but the entire rigged system that puts power in the hands of special interests, and leaves working people behind.
The only way we change that is by backing and electing leaders who answer to working people — nobody else. Not corporations. Not billionaires. Not Trump.
**[Will you pitch in $5 right now to help Leaders We Deserve continue doing exactly that?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260402_1_bondi.JxUtqM&refcode=em20260402-3326&amount=5&t=3&akid=3326%2E587540%2E8T4I0J)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

Peter, No
Kings day was incredible.

Millions of people came out in cities and towns across all 50 states to
join the day of action. Some estimates put the total number at more than 8
million — a historic record for mass demonstrations.

We put Trump and the entire corrupt Republican Party on notice: The
American people are sick and tired of ICE brutality, billionaire-first
policies, endless wars, and hateful authoritarianism, and are ready to
vote you out.

Now it’s time to take the next step.

We just entered a brand new FEC fundraising period. This is our next
opportunity to send another message of strength and defiance against
Trump’s reign of terror.

I'm setting an ambitious goal to make this our movement’s biggest few
months of fundraising ever. If we can hit that goal, it would be a serious
warning shot to MAGA, AIPAC, the billionaire class, and the entire
establishment that if they want to take down this campaign, they have to
go through thousands of grassroots supporters who are committed to the
fight for progress.

And it would be a serious sign of strength for our entire movement — a
movement that believes in Medicare-for-All, abolishing ICE, affordable
housing for every American, ending our complicity in Israel’s violence
against Palestinians, and much more.

towards meeting our goals, no matter the amount, as long as everyone does

As I was preparing seder last night, I found myself reminiscing on a very different, more austere Pesach I celebrated almost a quarter century ago.
It was just after 9/11. I was serving aboard _USS Enterprise_ and _ _ decided to host a seder for a dozen fellow crew members in the ship’s library. We read the military prayer book version of the Haggadah, ate matzoh, and sang the Four Questions. All while three inches of steel separated us from the jets being deployed on the flight deck above our heads.
_(Unfortunately Elijah didn’t have the security clearance to come aboard, and you can probably understand why we suspended the afikomen search that year.)_
Last night, my family came together in Coastal Virginia to hear the same stories I once recited onboard an aircraft carrier in the Indian Ocean; stories my family told in Birmingham and in Poland, Lithuania, and Germany before that. And we will think of those Sailors deployed today who are far from their families during this Passover.
In the Exodus, we defied our oppressors by reclaiming our humanity, freedom, and self-determination for future generations. These values are the reason I joined the Navy at 17, the reason I ran for Congress, and the reason I will always defend the rights and freedoms of all Virginians.
Those who dabble in hate will always try to turn neighbors against neighbors and friends against friends. But they cannot take our humanity. They cannot take our courage. We will remain free if we stand together.
**To all of you who celebrate, Chag Sameach from my family to yours!**
Together,
Elaine Luria

Hi there.

I want to thank you for your support and letting us know that you would like to volunteer for my campaign. We are coming off of a very successful quarter... name: Josh Shapiro
subject: Will you personally endorse me for reelection?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA]
body:
[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/signup/community-endorser/?t=1001&akid=11%2E245147%2EFenbxI ]Josh Shapiro Headshot

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/signup/community-endorser/?t=1002&akid=11%2E245147%2EFenbxI ]Hey there, it’s Josh Shapiro. I wanted to personally reach out and ask
you to become an official Community Endorser of my reelection campaign
here in Pennsylvania →

It’s been just a few months since we launched this campaign — and
Derek, it’s humbling to know so many people across Pennsylvania
are lining up behind our team and our message of moving the Commonwealth
forward.

But Derek, elections aren’t won in the first few months. They’re
won in April, May, June, and every single month that comes after. That’s
why it’s so important we keep this campaign moving full-speed ahead — not
only from a financial standpoint, but by continuing to bring in new people
to our team as well.

Listen, I know our dedicated grassroots movement is stronger than any one
far-right super PAC. Stronger than their fear and misinformation. Stronger
than every smear and attack they throw our way. But now, I need your help
to prove it.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/signup/community-endorser/?t=1003&akid=11%2E245147%2EFenbxI ]If we’re going to win, we need all hands on deck. Please, take a moment
to personally endorse my campaign for reelection →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/signup/community-endorser/?t=1004&akid=11%2E245147%2EFenbxI ]Add Your Name →

Pennsylvania is one of the nation’s most competitive battleground states —
and if we’re going to win it, we need to build the broadest, strongest,
most energized coalition possible. None of us can stay on the sidelines.
There’s too much at stake.

Thank you for being a part of this campaign,
Derek.

With gratitude,

Josh Shapiro

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with supporters like you.
Unsubscribe: https://act.joshshapiro.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1005&akid=11%2E245147%2EFenbxI

name: Andrew Sypher, Turning Point USA
subject: When Charlie said “35,000,” I laughed...
body:
Before you give up on America — read this| | | [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=4a0b575908c0467fb8932acf7c69c1ef&_e=6i5vtKZHVLrzLJwd2HRS__rYRLeBOGYiNRShP7CirRuoC5qwNpIA6YK6Oswvi2RtZwOiHbJOWCZxI-9iNUR9WnORVq9GzwBX-rEPZNR80N_N-M-lfMY2AuR3vNPF_fAHHR6jIiOGl0-dRUVOdeThdifDf-q4-HNrpg1uwEE85tHIXYKlR76vfg2kZ0AJcl2dPUveTS6VIuraVZCtDM9Zfe-HmLnN9ZwPk6o62WKatlUkJ_YlOUAWerm06I-prmB5qzg27qPs2SocJFy5sUmroFqb-U6DQ37cor7Z6am_G6zG6M19kJwItHjji_rqQhy_dbDhxCnWrR_Be5id_NeqUtDUW6tLogNhQnNBRS2DY8tVfxky_pldB1zKggdKimzQ1-nskV8eT9_QaA0YQtR7Aw%3D%3D)
---
| | Patriot,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **
---
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=4a0b575908c0467fb8932acf7c69c1ef&_e=6i5vtKZHVLrzLJwd2HRS__rYRLeBOGYiNRShP7CirRuoC5qwNpIA6YK6Oswvi2RtZwOiHbJOWCZxI-9iNUR9WnORVq9GzwBX-rEPZNR80N_N-M-lfMY2AuR3vNPF_fAHHR6jIiOGl0-dRUVOdeThdifDf-q4-HNrpg1uwEE85tHIXYKlR76vfg2kZ0AJcl2dPUveTS6VIuraVZCtDM9Zfe-HmLnN9ZwPk6o62WKatlUkJ_YlOUAWerm06I-prmB5M9gS1kBLoHGCLu__-RNJvfJJXVzVH1DVdXDmmboVJLC5Rjde_4l6PtfW0p4qew7fUzm5gCGsCRRPFz-a-GBOngM303qgnuUBud8wvf7jTPM2Lncx7EWbDa90MeHKVNVCpNHNaqLV1sfQces-D-l9Kw%3D%3D)
---
We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **
---
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=4a0b575908c0467fb8932acf7c69c1ef&_e=6i5vtKZHVLrzLJwd2HRS__rYRLeBOGYiNRShP7CirRuoC5qwNpIA6YK6Oswvi2RtZwOiHbJOWCZxI-9iNUR9WnORVq9GzwBX-rEPZNR80N_N-M-lfMY2AuR3vNPF_fAHHR6jIiOGl0-dRUVOdeThdifDf-q4-HNrpg1uwEE85tHIXYKlR76vfg2kZ0AJcl2dPUveTS6VIuraVZCtDM9Zfe-HmLnN9ZwPk6o62WKatlUkJ_YlOUAWerm06I-prmB5CzoT0UCCoOuA1Jc82FDtZwPWhDf_9iv3Xs7YuNzTlpVh4uiAnaPe29HOiZzz5aUeDcDHB1fymeAREp_Wml8wqPR7BaSg9mCJLEQWmTszW0jPEkwht4jfnX1yCo0LoOPN5-QhZCi0WovrsHAdJEthvQ%3D%3D)
---
_But now, Patriot, the question is... _

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.

**Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. **

**We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. **

These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses.

Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship.

**[If you're able to, I hope you'll help send a kit to the next student who raises their hand to lead by making your gift to Turning Point USA today.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=4a0b575908c0467fb8932acf7c69c1ef&_e=6i5vtKZHVLrzLJwd2HRS__rYRLeBOGYiNRShP7CirRuoC5qwNpIA6YK6Oswvi2RtZwOiHbJOWCZxI-9iNUR9WnORVq9GzwBX-rEPZNR80N_N-M-lfMY2AuR3vNPF_fAHHR6jIiOGl0-dRUVOdeThdifDf-q4-HNrpg1uwEE85tHIXYKlR76vfg2kZ0AJcl2dPUveTS6VIuraVZCtDM9Zfe-HmLnN9ZwPk6o62WKatlUkJ_YlOUAWerm06I-prmB5I4GmkBIfAHHvt-dmGcatHd7GAHd2ZQOfZQixW57KjDxgJjCzBD9VWj8ldcvyN043CdCi0mpwd87nogWG9MYSwIYTlFeeCTT5kU_xI77xrXRWg46Fuw-rFFV1DNrp8T66b5RyHsGegjewS_6nM7m4zA%3D%3D)**
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Today**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=4a0b575908c0467fb8932acf7c69c1ef&_e=6i5vtKZHVLrzLJwd2HRS__rYRLeBOGYiNRShP7CirRuoC5qwNpIA6YK6Oswvi2RtZwOiHbJOWCZxI-9iNUR9WnORVq9GzwBX-rEPZNR80N_N-M-lfMY2AuR3vNPF_fAHHR6jIiOGl0-dRUVOdeThdifDf-q4-HNrpg1uwEE85tHIXYKlR76vfg2kZ0AJcl2dPUveTS6VIuraVZCtDM9Zfe-HmLnN9ZwPk6o62WKatlUkJ_YlOUAWerm06I-prmB5SV6rHGShwNzWhYByNWcCqvfS26VnVDc1CxA5KCOuvvu6Kdd4mlKSffoV0PIh3pakeQSyTAOk_ehdxlttXwCET5wdoHQitYgcOM9gNOPoEMk4lWpM4-gJoUwTBpyxPbwCnH1YDaimNH7NJQbh781Ccw%3D%3D)
---
Charlie wanted a Club America chapter in every high school so no student would ever feel alone for loving God, defending their country, or believing in truth.

And so the next generation wouldn't be handed over to the Left by default.

Let's make Charlie's dream real -- 27,000 high schools. And a generation that doesn't apologize for loving this country.

It's up to us to finish what he started.

One chapter. One student. One school at a time.

Let's move faster. Let's push further. Let's get this done -- for Charlie, and for the country we all love.
---
| | **For Charlie,** **Andrew Sypher** Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA
---

[ _**Support Turning Point USA**_](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=4a0b575908c0467fb8932acf7c69c1ef&_e=6i5vtKZHVLrzLJwd2HRS__rYRLeBOGYiNRShP7CirRuoC5qwNpIA6YK6Oswvi2RtZwOiHbJOWCZxI-9iNUR9WnORVq9GzwBX-rEPZNR80N_N-M-lfMY2AuR3vNPF_fAHHR6jIiOGl0-dRUVOdeThdifDf-q4-HNrpg1uwEE85tHIXYKlR76vfg2kZ0AJcl2dPUveTS6VIuraVZCtDM9Zfe-HmLnN9ZwPk6o62WKatlUkJ_YlOUAWerm06I-prmB5xAYKNOPp7BAWeWGLWLmi5giGjVexId_1WUTMf7-QKQnA4WTbtsC_Kq4dI0VHvwg9XXzaFOoD3rPAHHf8HntScOmV_r5517j_Xa4Cn6TuGw_6x-gEFihrKkTEeZTK4MTvAxL-Av9cOocMIgGBx3g6YQ%3D%3D)
---
**P.S.** There's one part of that phone call with Charlie I was going to leave out...

He wasn't just dreaming big -- he was issuing a warning.

When he told me we needed to move faster, he added: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. _**We don 't have time to wait.**_**" **

And he was right.

The Left has deeply embedded themselves in our schools -- rewriting history, poisoning young minds, and raising their next generation of radical foot soldiers.

We may be in 13% of our schools now...

_But in the other 87%? _

The Left has free rein. Zero resistance. No voice to challenge them.

And if we don't flood those schools with truth -- fast -- we'll have a generation that thinks loving America is "fascist," that faith is "hateful," and that freedom and free speech is "dangerous."

You know it. I know it. Charlie knew it.

He knew the fight for America's future would be won or lost in high school classrooms and on college campuses.

And that fight has never been more urgent than it is right now.

**Patriot, if you 've ever wondered whether one small act could change the direction of our country -- _this is it._ **

You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do.

But you can send them the tools to do it.

These students are ready. They've raised their hands. They chose courage and decided to lead.

All they're waiting on... is us.

**Every $25 helps send an activism kit to a young patriot and gives them everything they need to win hearts and minds. **

You're gift reminds them they're not alone. It gives them the confidence to stand and fight back.

clean_body: Before you give up on America — read this| | | | | Patriot, If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left... If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good... If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, " Is it already too late?" You're not alone. A lot of good people have been asking the same question. But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools. That was no small feat. Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked. So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle. Then Charlie called me... He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster." I told him, "We are." Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools." I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America." "Okay," he said, "How many are there?" "About 27,000." Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!" I'll be honest -- I froze. We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet. But he wasn't fazed. He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together." That was Charlie. He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday." He believed in going now. And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself. He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality. That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place. That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: We're in 3,300. That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America. Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide. ✅ Florida ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee ✅ Oklahoma ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Arkansas ✅ Indiana And we're just getting started. Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country... That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom. That 's what Club America is about... Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. But now, Patriot, the question is... What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? Because here's the truth: These students aren't just signing up. They 're stepping up. They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous. But that isn't stopping them. They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever. They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, but brave. Not just loud, but principled. Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses. Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship. Charlie wanted a Club America chapter in every high school so no student would ever feel alone for loving God, defending their country, or believing in truth. And so the next generation wouldn't be handed over to the Left by default. Let's make Charlie's dream real -- 27,000 high schools. And a generation that doesn't apologize for loving this country. It's up to us to finish what he started. One chapter. One student. One school at a time. Let's move faster. Let's push further. Let's get this done -- for Charlie, and for the country we all love. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. There's one part of that phone call with Charlie I was going to leave out... He wasn't just dreaming big -- he was issuing a warning. When he told me we needed to move faster, he added: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. We don 't have time to wait." And he was right. The Left has deeply embedded themselves in our schools -- rewriting history, poisoning young minds, and raising their next generation of radical foot soldiers. We may be in 13% of our schools now... But in the other 87%? The Left has free rein. Zero resistance. No voice to challenge them. And if we don't flood those schools with truth -- fast -- we'll have a generation that thinks loving America is "fascist," that faith is "hateful," and that freedom and free speech is "dangerous." You know it. I know it. Charlie knew it. He knew the fight for America's future would be won or lost in high school classrooms and on college campuses. And that fight has never been more urgent than it is right now. Patriot, if you 've ever wondered whether one small act could change the direction of our country -- this is it. You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do. But you can send them the tools to do it. These students are ready. They've raised their hands. They chose courage and decided to lead. All they're waiting on... is us. Every $25 helps send an activism kit to a young patriot and gives them everything they need to win hearts and minds. You're gift reminds them they're not alone. It gives them the confidence to stand and fight back. And you'll be saving our country -- one future freedom fighter at a time. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

| Patriot, I'll be honest with you. I've been watching the debate over the SAVE America Act in Washington — and while I'm cheering for it to pass, I've been in this fight long enough to know something most people won't say: **We cannot afford to wait on Washington to save our elections.** While politicians debate, the Democrat ground game does not stop. Their voter registration staffers are at their tables right now. Their ballot chasers are making their calls. Their door knockers are hitting their lists. _And if we are not doing the same thing — right now — we are falling behind._ **I know this because I've lived it.** In 2024, my team spent over a year embedded on the ground in Pennsylvania before Election Day. We helped register hundreds of thousands of new Republican voters. We chased down every outstanding mail-in ballot we legally could. We drove voters to the polls on Election Day. **That is why Pennsylvania went red.** Not because of any law. Not because of any court ruling. Because of boots on the ground, day after day, doing the unglamorous, exhausting, absolutely essential work of grassroots organizing.

You’ve made this campaign grow stronger.
# [](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/685?refcode=&t=1&akid=4366%2E898137%2EnzNQ5A)
Hi There, one year ago today, we launched our campaign for Senate.
[](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/4?c0=mam-em-april2026.vCnu4h&refcode=AU_MAM_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260402_PM1_V1_S1&t=2&akid=4366%2E898137%2EnzNQ5A)
Over the past 12 months, we’ve been across Michigan, earned key endorsements, and received more grassroots contributions than our opponents combined.
We’ve met Michiganders where they are — on their doorsteps, in breweries and union halls and churches, and at parades and farmers' markets.
At every stop, we’ve heard the same thing over and over again: Government isn’t working for you and your family, and you’re tired of a broken Washington.
That’s why I launched this campaign — to build a better tomorrow not in the halls of think tanks and committee rooms filled with people with no real-world experience, but by listening to you — your ideas, your challenges, your dreams. Because the people who got us into the mess won’t be the ones to get us out of it, but we will. It’s hard to believe that it’s been a year. There is still a lot of hard work ahead of us. We’re just about seven months away from Election Day, and things are going to get harder, uglier, and (much) more expensive.
I still believe in the promise of a better tomorrow, and I’m more motivated than ever before.

But we met our fundraising goal for the first quarter - and I want to say a big THANK YOU to everyone who helped make it happen.
You showed up for this campaign.
And it means a lot. Because I can't do this alone. Not when we are up against one of the richest members of Congress who can fill a Florida ballroom with donors who can give $3,500 a pop.
It also matters. Because you're the reason we're able to compete. You're the reason we can host events, mobilize the community, buy yard signs and buttons, and reach voters in every corner of PA-09. You're the reason we're able to keep gaining momentum and building a campaign strong enough to win.
So thank you for believing in affordable health care, in making national politics about local issues, and in the kind of leadership our part of Pennsylvania deserves. I'm grateful you're a part of this team.
Let's go win this together.
- Rachel Wallace

body:
| | | This moment is demanding more from all of us, Peter. Across the country, Working Families Party candidates, volunteers, and members are stepping up — taking on the establishment, winning tough fights, and building power for working people at every level. **Here’s just some of what the Working Families Party has been up to over the past month:**
* * *
**_BUILDING POWER IN 2026... FROM THE GROUND UP:_** While we’re going full speed to take back the House and Senate from Republicans in 2026 and elect working families champions to replace them, we’re also focused on building power where it starts: **in our states and local communities.** Over the past month, WFP and our chapters across the country have started knocking on doors, talking to voters, and organizing our neighbors to elect working families champions running at every level of government — from school boards and county commissions to state legislatures and mayors. _(And this is just a snapshot, Peter._[**_Click here for our full — and growing — list of 2026 endorsements across the country!_**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMYd6eLP33O2GRZpvuK-wGuT88MQ6QTt1yWtXvBm7uYjEoXCqo9n4zG0oOkYC3Et_Onl4TgQP3tSjxGmCLdvnnNFPQSimzentiY6oyEkl6c9LZqSN1lYbdgQY5A8Af0IRAJWoFO8xqMue_R_avweJ33wgoareLoJwp8LFS8sl0bOyQTZugkx_vrETeLI4I2XFp3INoETSK_OnU5f2J9-wuV-ZDbZE49T0VHS3OiVmOmFpARxsEfB3pxSmUw83lYlAOw/4pg/LZwv2wfqSiC7gbbrjxv3rw/h0/h001.hIgRFQTK1ElnBJs6-96LbKKbsWqLECms1fTP_DTf7vo)_)_
* In **Georgia** , that includes **Ruwa Romman** for State Senate, District 7, along with **Aaron Baker** , **Kenn Collier** , **Jyot Singh** , **Michelle Kang** , **Alana Sanders** , **Gabriel Sanchez** , **Bryce Berry** , and **Marvin Lim** for State House. We’re also supporting **Keyanna Jones Moore** for DeKalb County Commission and **Kerry Hatcher** and **Adrienne Simmons** for local school boards.
* In **New Jersey** , we’ve endorsed **Ron Bautista** and **David Gurgis** in Hudson County and **Ali Aljarrah** in Passaic for County Commissioners.
* In **Pennsylvania** , we’re backing **Sara Agerton** , **Ce-Ce Gerlach** , **Sierra McNeil** , and **Chris Johnson** for State House.
* In **Oregon** , we’ve endorsed **Isabella Lee Tibbetts** for Jackson County Commission, **Myrna Muñoz** for State Senate, District 15, and **John (Waz) Wasielewski** for State House, District 38.
* And in **Ohio** , we’re supporting **Bryan Hambley** for Secretary of State, **Davida Russell** for State Representative in HD-18, and **Charity Martin King** for State Representative in HD-2, alongside the Columbus **“Our City, Our Voice”** ballot measure.

These are just _some_ of the candidates we’ve endorsed in the past month, Peter. Across _every_ region of the country, we’re backing many more working families champions — both incumbents and challengers — who are rooted in their communities and ready to take on corporate power and right-wing attacks, and to fight for housing, healthcare, good jobs, and dignity for all. [**If you’re able, chip in here to help the Working Families Party train candidates, organize locally, and mobilize voters in races that shape people’s daily lives.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T91-xFcLhdwDw_WW2ntLoOUdDQ7ELL1axCDBzPA5_nuvCdrjD1YSqTpDOBxtjRe2PAAHlb8XdLMLdMR9usrI2UpBSbowb-kfocPz2hQPJeVUJMMJ2kywCHiunsoFDaVTOat8U2CmemTVKFWjpLbeDjnycvEqy_dN7-3_26WgKQr_HeucvjiDhRHzsUYGdHNr0w5CBEM1PweEBsVUU_W9whk82Hpmj72KA_BMMFsYG5v86DqvzN4IHpZpKxlXssOoZWa-JzJDx6UgkkeR8jtY1pQkbzb1BZqLV6fPDonhT3zcFxCYAnjTxQsy6iHGwdo5y-/4pg/LZwv2wfqSiC7gbbrjxv3rw/h1/h001.lrjWITAUdiFAHkmu1FMsxiI0g-D0rH0zSBhyfePRiiU)
* * *
**_HOLDING U.S. SENATOR JOHN FETTERMAN ACCOUNTABLE:_** We’re also laying the groundwork to hold elected officials accountable when they turn their backs on working people. **In Pennsylvania, that means John Fetterman.** Over the past year, Fetterman has repeatedly sided with the far right — including **voting with Republicans to block a War Powers Resolution to stop Trump’s war on Iran** , and **reversing his position on voter ID laws** , going from calling them “insidious” to backing them despite the barriers they create for working-class voters and communities of color. Last month, Pennsylvania WFP made it clear: we’re building toward a future primary challenge — recruiting a strong candidate, organizing statewide, and holding Fetterman accountable every step of the way. We’ve launched [**PrimaryFetterman.com**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.MKNRc_Uoq_UnyjrT0RZScjQ_4K4gSVrsi4mYcDNIVD3rfda8z0UKtndVrHsHKmmyJmspkZ7HX_WDfj6ssJNUuq_-tiitYm2iTNem1lj4yR9Eryuzx-QESFopWc-8zGi_GB_-cx1J_kTDL5my0dbXCpQoI97dboHB7AfAxQesHuA1_KiImSjIO283xIBFeVOFgwvn5__vM3AxdK5rp8no8KtY4sPalJO1f3eyv8b8JusfjWp-gzGcf0Ke9mlJqQ4f9wxjl3l_6HfJKIgENjPXzQ/4pg/LZwv2wfqSiC7gbbrjxv3rw/h2/h001.J_5zNNzxHADA9RUsZn_0gtM8M-CGv89rE7kCyzE1Dbo) as a hub for this work, and we’re building the long-term campaign it will take to recruit a strong challenger, organize statewide, and replace him with leadership that is accountable to working people — not corporate power or political convenience. Because this is bigger than one senator. Across the country, too many politicians campaign with working people, then govern for the wealthy. We’re not waiting until the last minute to challenge that — we’re building power now. [**If you’re with us, pitch in to WFP’s “Primary Fetterman Fund” and help us recruit, organize, and elect new leadership to replace John Fetterman in the Senate.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9QAeIQT3BIzcD8YPl_es8JjH41Z6K0IBamMXY9YMPTvELGnTXdzYV65ng9yfM8Ji3pYjSm3dLIImW7fQDY7RKm4YbUDZJcBul4Fwfms2rAzcdzPXw5WaLoQ-ooAdYo_lm9IlpsL1dwn4Qv9TgOAP_I9B9Aj6LrJu89R7kQonksC2U6YViDq_58qk8uUbu2I_C9uwaG4sd762glvmoKkVYqRNo3q6vPgWIbgYsRVmzHQrCVNU81qnMHgeHWqFQGBeodAIZu505Rrt5Z7_FIjv_qQ8_UtihBopA77PByqLHkkuqEnF_PhRmfU38cX4pBzQz/4pg/LZwv2wfqSiC7gbbrjxv3rw/h3/h001.VY42rjLEZhAyHjNp4y4zPTCL0_eFCsogN-ClJuA7-CI)
* * *
**_JUSTICE FOR US:_** The Working Families Party’s**Criminal Justice Initiative** recently notched notable wins in its work to build power to disrupt mass incarceration and systems that disproportionately affect working people. In Arkansas, **Bobby Forrest Jr.** defeated an incumbent backed by Governor Sarah Huckabee Sanders to become Prosecuting Attorney for the 6th Judicial District, covering Pulaski and Perry Counties — a major victory for accountability and reform. In North Carolina, CJI supported incumbent District Attorney **Satana Deberry** in her re-election in Durham County, where she’s building an office that prioritizes diversion and restorative justice. In Mecklenburg County, Sheriff Garry McFadden also secured another term after ending the county’s 287(g) program that led to the deportation of 15,000 county residents. These wins reflect a growing momentum to dismantle systems of mass incarceration and build a justice system rooted in care, accountability, and real safety for our communities.
* * *
**_SAY LESS, OREGON WFP:_** Oregon Working Families Party’s growing influence is getting noticed. A recent [**_Oregon Capital Chronicle_****headline**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.s333gSbyhQmXsyCO3lhAD5n3w1zZsulLYJlkILxqzmSXDIjH4y4pG4B0xWoPGntp0athVAr9eRg3G8XmkGoBHWCV2P4A-1GGeqtRfyESj7tiCSYrQER-UQPbhOtpFasw0GP0ajso3xWIs1CuFD8n54rzR2qDaIFidD-LqblTj_cDpWEQ712X3dqCOelk-4iqkbw36aq6KHkykS3e4T1fFUUDQQnK-fuOJ12v2-85JdKNNhJK9wAwgoLhkRC0pHLRYo-9ArK8k6LlxJvbKLYzOZu0rao9FafIFFp_3VysV4b3xJPmypBBHCCRfnz3nmQBd346p0NeDEejqkEEVXXulzOy01P5BCRrFKvR-RwpnhnxeuJq24KQ8fulqiw6He1_E4GiMh_CbZ_wFVIg4SDk89fmU5UBd1gEiXkZkIw98O0/4pg/LZwv2wfqSiC7gbbrjxv3rw/h4/h001.Kcc1T8Ehcf1-lScNL9HFWCUsxhL2qlNm4r0hbt0Lv_8) pointed out the Party’s lack of an endorsement in the upcoming gubernatorial primary — a sign of its political weight. Instead, Oregon WFP endorsed a [**diverse slate**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMYd6eLP33O2GRZpvuK-wGuSFDRnO6a1XTIJo0Xo_mhJguQ9stoBOmRXW9atMsp1eUCHJtYCJalUiUGhIOONequwbElYzIKAy0i6HnoY2eMJFlXeRJqrG34RZ7AibMWEchQkCbmpTPbrfI3cO147ktRdJ6HjunJWyjMTXQj-AtPc3AH1llqncq1lVimezJmWGFPAfNQjC8zHeZCDaxpzPp1tACYrYLf514klO0gGYZam9CAlN6aV5A6nnOzeQEjIrezaQH1aQiZ2XI9U18p_fUtQ/4pg/LZwv2wfqSiC7gbbrjxv3rw/h5/h001.t4wsOTIRoNYrzE8F9rvZXQ_BoC6VHTOsOWj3iCMgOhQ) of municipal and state legislative candidates who center the struggles of working people. That strategy is delivering results. Oregon’s legislative session just wrapped with major wins, including an immigrant rights package with **$111 million** to protect SNAP participants, **$2 million** in emergency support for refugees and immigrants, and **$8 million** to expand legal services for children and families separated from a caregiver. Oregon WFP also helped lead the push to keep hundreds of millions of dollars in the state by partially disconnecting from the federal tax code. While not the full measure advocates pushed for, it helps fill a budget gap and prevent cuts to essential services. The bill is expected to be signed by Gov. Tina Kotek. Shoutout to WFP champions **Rep. Farrah Chaichi** , **Rep. Lesly Muñoz** , **Rep. Willy Chotzen** , **Sen. Kayse Jama** , and **Sen. Winsvey Campos** for getting the people’s business done in Salem.
* * *
**_BUILDING WFP IN NORTH CAROLINA:_** In North Carolina, Working Families Party candidates have been taking on the establishment — and winning. In HD-106, **Rodney Sadler** unseated a Democratic incumbent who sided with Republicans and supported cooperation with ICE — a decisive break from politics that criminalize and abandon working people. WFP champions **Renée Ann Price** and **Rodney Pierce** _also_ won re-election, continuing to build power for communities too often shut out of decision-making. And although **Nida Allam** fell just one point short in the Durham-area congressional primary, her campaign made clear how close we are to breaking through — even while being outspent two-to-one by AI and AIPAC money. These races show both the scale of what we’re up against and how close we are to breaking through — with working people organizing to challenge the status quo and win bigger fights ahead.
* * *
**_NEW MEXICO STATE LEGISLATORS TO GET PAID:_** In a major step toward a more representative democracy, New Mexico lawmakers passed a _long_ -overdue proposal to pay state legislators — breaking down a key barrier that has kept working people out of office. **New Mexico is the last state in the country with an unpaid legislature, forcing everyday people to shoulder the financial burden of serving while wealthy insiders hold onto power.** If voters approve the measure this November, legislators would earn about **$67,000 a year** — roughly the state’s median household income — making it possible for working-class candidates to run and serve without sacrificing their livelihoods. The proposal, backed by New Mexico WFP, is already facing opposition from oil and gas interests and wealthy lawmakers who benefit from the status quo. **Now, New Mexico WFP is helping lead the fight to win at the ballot — educating voters on what’s at stake and building support to open the doors of government to working people.**
* * *
**_NO MORE ENDLESS WAR:_** Across the country, working people are speaking out against another devastating war — and making it clear: we refuse to let more violence be carried out in our name. **Earlier this month, we asked our supporters to weigh in through a**[**WFP Supporter Survey**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoe1DuqQbjt4KoloTZxD-XRKpjgzvVoraRa6X5vX2XliRCa3Hu7Sco54gr4fc-u59YiB04LzBAcO-iSwR1OtUNoRvbUHJDj4n0VlMTinJ-5ES7QIm5QssfqOQgfISFsgzGmd_juPETTJZsN1OXrqe4pyzMNoQ6Xdql-APk5xD0tRAyiINBlei9vAg8jNkm-KK6ejvvDwAguuHaR3wu7rod_oKlMnErRuESJ06Fzn0Affq3GeAPQv49arI44818L9DseCY1_qCDkbrafbBxoCfJHg/4pg/LZwv2wfqSiC7gbbrjxv3rw/h6/h001.eS9guOe_R_epr3gyhIf_reti6HHk027avT-HG071b4w) **on the war in Iran. The responses were clear: people are scared, angry, and overwhelmingly opposed to this war.** What’s unfolding is devastating. Families are being torn apart, communities are living in fear, and people are being forced to endure violence they did not choose. And war isn’t just fought overseas. It puts American troops’ lives on the line, drives up costs for working people here at home, and pulls billions of dollars away from healthcare, housing, education, and the things our communities actually need. This is a political choice. Time and again, we’re told there’s no money for working people — but there is always money for war. Meanwhile, politicians in Washington continue to escalate violence while ignoring the real needs of the people they represent. [**Add your name to demand Congress step in: not a single dollar more for Trump’s illegal war — and a government that invests in our communities instead of destruction.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoe1DuqQbjt4KoloTZxD-XRIq_Rq3KohZ4y2Iu5_arjN9-W3f5EPLTOZcNMqvgnDAP_HKg8bvFbJXI2aiEr0VtN5355ekloDX8fyGHqOx-WKW-spS9WDpzEAtQILc72Wa4V67nO6-HEek--z0MnKW-xs4j7MPhPzK4O69zTiPxbiMbRk4MQkyQgyBuLk4ovFDCEz_vS4uhA4oawLxohCOZlL084j_2gukDqsIwUkKF4kwiercDMZ9gVPNKI7fZaRvgzBFkwEE4Tfd3CEYWftm60behKC8-FCK6Jl0joAuy30fUhcZii0JKlIE87EH3DMrHI8bK8GVPF0Ipx1rwo5L22g/4pg/LZwv2wfqSiC7gbbrjxv3rw/h7/h001.O0iEantZ3KLQZO6x7iTsed8PRUSnnbZX-NDbSmJ2nJk)
* * *
**_BIG TECH IS DRIVING UP COSTS. WE’RE ORGANIZING TO FIGHT BACK:_** Across the country, working people are seeing their utility bills rise — even when their usage hasn’t changed. One major driver: **AI data centers.** These facilities are driving up electricity demand, draining water, increasing pollution, and reshaping communities — while utility companies pass the costs onto us and guarantee profits for Big Tech. We’re organizing to push back, and we’re looking for people ready to step up. [**If you’re thinking about running for local office, or want to help recruit and support candidates who will take on Big Tech, we want to hear from you.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoe1DuqQbjt4KoloTZxD-XRJzELDOvtVMlln665R2fyNmfc3gGDtgIWHko_t0a8VsNJOlyqjr0jh8HbG-qJr6s-cwrQrLRhkBNpBeH5WUX3ybQC5r7oDyISGYET7iJt3-ZhvefsVgDlQn4CTi5WXB9qBgN4Uiynbc1dxPWrwK1cvSMZKZgo0fQMuyKddsLjwcAoBICmQEc3TNTl_oTRyrFp4g1bII2hEq-h_Fl9kJG6ip-FBXi0k8mmVz0ncGTfDHgSrWhBU0eSQbZcJuX48nUn5ldKp7aX1O3NCKaHApw1DCHqHOA6iETcnA2GeW7O6Vog/4pg/LZwv2wfqSiC7gbbrjxv3rw/h8/h001.ZIq_-hnhRbngcM7xE6yd7lkU_BKAD3JjNkr2rn_hoyM)
* * *
**_VIDEO OF THE WEEK:_** **Taylor Rehmet** , endorsed by Texas Working Families Party, just won a special election for State Senate in a Trump +17 district — a major upset that shows what’s possible when working people organize. [](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMWn3R7U15hZOprFI75oZg44Fkk-geLCb35-IR5QRcBnLyRpiQUd8sONq2BxZspEdXLfnE4keuQs8HI8VFxzEHE1v9ifoiTC_josg9-fX1RvA3e0SGlIXUUjZXAyuNnX9ZYyD2TEI-_QyaAoPPNShHR4YiljjnogNQhvL2EJqEXN93hoq24WkFksAW4dyDrsdBTvNJkPkNLVQrWBKFsum_jfVconWA142B0QnasR7_zZiZeNU83pYhYN8yWuV0gEE1g/4pg/LZwv2wfqSiC7gbbrjxv3rw/h9/h001.poDqtKo5vPjtJUG6B8vMeUfR-9hUF2xshfJrSGljCt0) [**Check out his inspiring message here.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMWn3R7U15hZOprFI75oZg44Fkk-geLCb35-IR5QRcBnLQvsxuM6ZWnnw68iyRJSaYcMAIdbFGqkF8QWVoDMyXpXPRW_MqZ-s60GV3RAVU_pTqw5phY65Q-rqzJdDvbdYT2HBZD6PRr94MZCBj5way8ggAVdFm3j94VauaoDFm8FFYqZeYlnplhAmPBF_gxTEVYM0c0vpIuTev3DLxA78J7gURpIw6EXwyKv2bbSuDF0q1cgQy_RwLyaKeXUN-5Mi-_shB8bP8EzM3NHXiM-dFK0/4pg/LZwv2wfqSiC7gbbrjxv3rw/h10/h001.jcJKtXqLwQyqt8SH073fNTAWEhMU4AcD3sTuFSMGPwk)
* * *
